sections.name: Solo · Male-coded
sections.description: 20 single male-coded figures, mid-action and contemplative
sections.descriptionRu: 20 одиночных мужских фигур, в действии и в раздумьях

prompts.title: Puddle Leap
prompts.description: Mid-air over a courtyard puddle, library books clutched to the chest
prompts.descriptionRu: В воздухе над дворовой лужей, библиотечные книги прижаты к груди
prompts.body: SCENE: Low-angle view. A digital illustration of a figure mid-leap over a wide puddle on a cracked Soviet-era courtyard in late October. The figure is caught at the apex of the jump, both feet airborne, body twisted slightly mid-air. The figure's left arm is thrown back for balance, fingers splayed; the right arm clutches a heavy stack of unbound library books to the chest. Head is tilted down, eyes wide and locked on the puddle below in a startled, almost-laughing expression. The figure wears an oversized wool peacoat two sizes too big, dark green corduroy trousers cuffed at the ankle, and scuffed brown loafers. The puddle reflects a sliver of pale grey sky, a flickering streetlamp, and a single yellow leaf. The midground is a beige Khrushchevka facade with peeling paint, a row of identical balconies hung with drying linens. The background is a pale-grey sky with bare poplar branches cutting across it. Lighting is overcast diffuse, cool grey-blue, with a single warm sodium streetlamp tinting the puddle's edge amber. The mood is small joyful rebellion in a tired city. Shallow depth of field with the foreground books razor-sharp.

prompts.title: 3 A.M. Kitchen Counter
prompts.description: Cross-legged on the counter, pizza in one hand, ice cream spoon in the other
prompts.descriptionRu: Скрестив ноги на стойке, пицца в одной руке, ложка мороженого в другой
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration in 3:4 aspect ratio. A figure sits cross-legged on the kitchen counter at 3 a.m., centered in the frame, framed by hanging copper pots above and an open refrigerator below that spills cold blue light up over the legs. The figure is hunched forward, both knees drawn up; the left hand cradles a half-eaten cold slice of pizza with one bite missing; the right hand holds a dripping ice-cream spoon, hovering halfway to the mouth. Head is tilted back against an upper cabinet, eyes half-closed in glazed midnight bliss, mouth slightly parted. The figure wears a stretched-out band t-shirt, plaid boxer shorts, and one mismatched sock. The midground is a granite countertop scattered with crumbs, an open jar of pickles, a phone face-down glowing through the surface. Background: dim kitchen with a single under-cabinet warm yellow strip, the rest of the room swallowed in indigo darkness. Lighting is two-source - cold blue from the open fridge below, warm yellow from above - meeting on the figure's collarbone. The mood is dissociative comfort, the secret holiness of being awake when the world isn't. Shallow depth of field, slight digital grain. EFFECTS: sticker collage overlay, cool tones. The stickers are 90s puffy variety - cartoon ghosts, smiley faces, a glittery "★YES★", a tiny pizza slice, a heart with an arrow through it - scattered loosely on the fridge door behind the figure as if the kitchen itself has been defaced rather than the photograph.

prompts.title: Empty Concourse at Dawn
prompts.description: Tiny on a steamer trunk in a vast train station, dog at his feet
prompts.descriptionRu: Крошечная фигура на сундуке в огромном вокзале, собака у ног
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is seated on an old steamer trunk in the middle of a vast empty train station concourse at dawn. Extreme wide shot, figure tiny and centered. The trunk is plastered with peeling stickers from a dozen cities. The figure is in profile, knees together, both hands resting palms-down on the knees, back perfectly straight, head turned to look across the concourse toward an enormous mechanical departures board. The board's split-flap rows are mid-flip, frozen in a snowstorm of letters. The figure wears a long camel coat, a brimmed felt hat, polished boots. A single small dog (a wirehaired terrier) sits at the figure's feet, also looking at the board, ears pricked. The concourse is a cathedral of vaulted iron-and-glass, light grey marble floor, no other passengers, three pigeons strolling in the middle distance. A janitor's mop bucket sits abandoned far off. Lighting is pale yellow dawn pouring through enormous arched windows, cutting long buttery beams across the marble. Mood: civilized stoic departure.

prompts.title: Ringmaster on a Tightrope
prompts.description: Mid-balance on a rope strung between autumn trees, fox watching below
prompts.descriptionRu: Балансирует на канате между осенними деревьями, внизу смотрит лиса
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is captured from directly behind, walking a tightrope strung between two skeletal trees in an autumn forest. Wide shot, the rope a thin diagonal across the frame. The figure is in the exact middle of the rope, both arms extended for balance like a slow-motion crucifix, body bent slightly at the knees. The right hand holds a long thin balancing pole; the left hand is empty, fingers splayed. The figure wears a circus-ringmaster costume that is slightly too big - long red tailcoat, gold-trimmed waistcoat, white riding pants tucked into tall boots, a black top hat wedged firmly down. The forest floor below is a deep blanket of red and orange leaves, with one small fox sitting on its haunches looking up. The two trees anchoring the rope have iron rings hammered into them; their bark is silver-grey. The forest beyond recedes into a smoky autumn haze. A single bright leaf is suspended in the air mid-fall just past the figure's shoulder. Lighting is overcast warm autumn diffuse, no harsh shadows. Mood: dignified absurdity.

prompts.title: Tokyo Ramen Meditation
prompts.description: Eyes squeezed shut, noodle suspended mid-flight in steaming izakaya
prompts.descriptionRu: Глаза зажмурены, лапша подвешена в воздухе в дымящейся идзакая
prompts.body: SCENE: A close-up of a figure in profile, bent over a bowl of ramen at a counter inside a tiny Tokyo izakaya. Steam rises from the bowl in dramatic curls. The figure has slurped an enormous mouthful of noodles; a long noodle is suspended mid-flight between the chopsticks (held in the right hand) and the lips. The eyes are squeezed shut in deep noodle-meditation, eyebrows knotted, cheeks flushed from the heat. A drop of broth has freckled the figure's nose. The left hand holds the rim of the bowl steady. The figure wears a salaryman's white shirt slightly damp, tie loosened and flipped over the shoulder to keep it dry. Behind the figure, the cramped izakaya: paper lanterns, racks of bottles, a chef's hands working a flat-top, condensation on a small window, a calligraphy menu hung crooked. Lighting is warm tungsten and lantern glow with steam-diffraction. Mood: monastic glutton joy. NEGATIVE: chopsticks held incorrectly.

prompts.title: Holding the Big Fish
prompts.description: Golden-hour dock, an enormous silver fish, pure panicked uncertainty
prompts.descriptionRu: Закатный пирс, огромная серебряная рыба, чистая паническая растерянность
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands on a dock at golden hour holding an enormous, just-caught fish that's almost as long as the figure is tall. Wide-angle, the figure centered in the frame. Both arms strain to hold the fish horizontally at chest height. The fish is sleek silver with iridescent scales catching the sun, mouth open, glassy eye. The figure's posture is heroic but the face shows sheer panicked uncertainty: eyes wide, mouth in a small "uh" of disbelief. The figure wears denim overalls over a yellow shirt, rubber waders, a fishing hat with too many lures pinned. The dock is weathered grey planks. A red fishing rod leans against a piling. A bucket and tackle box sit by the figure's feet, the tackle box open and chaotic. Behind: a calm lake bouncing a low orange sun, a dark distant treeline, a single canoe pulled up on the far shore. Lens flare in the upper right. Mood: the photograph is being taken before the figure decides what to do next.

prompts.title: After the Wedding
prompts.description: Spent against the chapel wall at twilight, bouquet dangling from one hand
prompts.descriptionRu: Изможденный у стены часовни в сумерках, букет свисает с руки
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure leans against the outer wall of a small countryside chapel at the very end of a wedding day, captured medium-shot at three-quarter angle. The figure's back is pressed flat against the whitewashed stone wall, head tipped back to rest against it, eyes closed, a tiny exhausted smile playing on the lips. Both arms hang slack at the sides. The right hand still grips a half-empty champagne flute by the stem; the left hand holds a single dropped bouquet by its ribbon. The figure wears a dove-grey wedding suit slightly rumpled, the tie pulled loose, top button undone, one shoe unlaced. Around the figure, the white-washed chapel wall is climbing with ivy. The arched wooden door is closed behind the figure with rice still stuck to the threshold. To the right, a long line of fairy lights strung to a tree, glowing warm against the deepening sky. Far in the background, the silhouettes of the wedding party are still dancing in a lit gazebo. Lighting is twilight blue with the warm yellow of distant fairy lights catching the figure's profile. Mood: the spent calm after the most important day. EFFECTS: film grain, golden hour.

prompts.title: Hundred-Faceted Mirror
prompts.description: Subway station mirror shattered into a hundred reflections of one figure
prompts.descriptionRu: Зеркало в метро расколото на сотню отражений одной фигуры
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands in front of a cracked-mirror wall of an underground subway station, captured frontally. The mirror is fractured into a hundred angled facets, each containing a different fragment of the figure's reflection - an eye here, a mouth there, a hand pressing in a fragment far to the right, a kneeling pose impossibly visible in a low fragment. The actual figure stands in the center, body still and frontal, face composed in a small unreadable smile, both hands held quietly together in front of the chest. The figure wears a long charcoal coat, narrow black trousers, polished oxford shoes. Behind, the dim subway tunnel mouth is visible to the right, a train's headlights approaching. Tiled walls in white subway brick streaked with rust. The platform is empty save for a single newspaper drifting along the floor. Lighting is harsh white tube light buzzing from above, with the approaching train's twin headlamps starting to wash a pale gold glow into the mirror fragments. Mood: identity in a hundred simultaneous angles. NEGATIVE: incorrect reflection geometry - each fragment must show a plausible piece of the figure from its own angle.

prompts.title: Rooftop Cannonball
prompts.description: Airborne tuck above a sherbet-sky rooftop pool, shouting with joy
prompts.descriptionRu: Группировка в воздухе над крышным бассейном на закате, крик восторга
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands at the edge of a flat rooftop pool at twilight, captured from a low side angle. The figure is mid-cannonball - body fully airborne above the water, knees pulled to chest in a tight tuck, both arms wrapped around the shins. The face is locked in a wide unselfconscious shout of joy, mouth open, eyes screwed shut. The pool below is a perfect blue rectangle catching a band of pink sky on its surface; ripples haven't started yet. The figure wears plain navy swim trunks, no shirt, a wristwatch left on (the only accessory), a stripe of zinc sunscreen still visible across the nose. The figure's left hand grips the right wrist for tightness; both feet point. Around the pool: an empty white deck chair with a folded towel, a sweating bottle of beer, a paperback face-down with a cracked spine, a portable speaker mid-song. Beyond the pool's far edge, the city skyline drops away to a sherbet sunset, distant rooftops of unlit air-conditioning units. Lighting is high-contrast - warm pink wash from the sky on the right, cool blue from the pool reflecting up onto the underside of the airborne body. Shallow depth of field. Mood: the absolute moment before the splash erases the silence.

prompts.title: Midnight Bike Shop
prompts.description: Hunched at a workbench under a single lamp, chain link in tweezers
prompts.descriptionRu: Согнулся над верстаком под одной лампой, звено цепи в пинцете
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration of a figure hunched over a workbench in a small bicycle repair shop at midnight, lit by a single swing-arm desk lamp. Captured at a 3/4 angle from across the bench. The figure leans forward with both elbows planted on the bench. The right hand grips a small wrench at an awkward angle, knuckles white; the left hand holds a tiny chain link in tweezers a centimeter from the eyes, brow furrowed in laser concentration, the tip of the tongue caught between teeth. The figure wears a faded mechanic's jumpsuit half-unzipped to the waist with the sleeves tied off at the hips, a sweat-soaked white tank top, a thick leather belt with a kit of small tools, hands black with chain grease that has streaked one cheek. The bench is chaos: an upended bicycle frame, a coffee cup full of bolts, a soldering iron resting on its stand, a torn parts diagram pinned with three thumbtacks, an oily rag, a half-eaten sandwich on wax paper. The walls of the shop are pegboard with the silhouettes of every tool drawn in marker. A radio plays. Lighting is a single hard incandescent cone from the desk lamp, warm yellow, casting deep crisp shadows across the figure's working hands; everything else fades into umber dimness. Mood: late-night problem-solving devotion.

prompts.title: Last Car, 1 A.M.
prompts.description: Slumped on the subway with bodega flowers, private smile half-formed
prompts.descriptionRu: Развалился в метро с букетом из ларька, едва уловимая улыбка
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure rides the New York subway alone in the last car at 1 a.m., captured from the seat across. The figure sits with legs spread wide, weight slumped sideways onto the right armrest, head dropped back against the window. The right arm hangs over the seat-back; the left hand cradles a cheap bodega flower bouquet upright in the lap, three single-stem roses still in their plastic sleeve. The face is exhausted but smiling - eyes half-closed, mouth in a small private grin as if remembering what the flowers are for. The figure wears a wrinkled navy suit jacket unbuttoned over a white shirt half-untucked, the tie shoved into a side pocket and dangling out, scuffed brogues, a hospital-visitor wristband still on. Behind the figure, the subway car windows show the dark tunnel sliding past in horizontal streaks of orange-and-grey light. Above the seats, ad placeholders read "PLACE NAME" and "YOUR CALL TO ACTION" in white sans-serif. The car is otherwise empty save for a single shoe abandoned at the far end. The bench is acid-green plastic. The floor has a wad of newspaper. Lighting is the cold blue-white of subway fluorescents from overhead, with the cabin's emergency-yellow undertone flickering once. Mood: the private rehearsal of what to say at the door.

prompts.title: Back Porch, Golden Hour
prompts.description: Leaning on the railing in a long lazy contrapposto, cat on the rail
prompts.descriptionRu: Опирается на перила в ленивом контрапосто, кот сидит рядом
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration of a figure on the back porch of a small wooden house in the rural American South, captured medium-wide from the yard at golden hour. The figure leans on the porch railing with both forearms, chin resting on the back of his stacked fists, gaze fixed on a far point past the camera. Body weight is on the right hip, the left foot crossed behind the right ankle in a long lazy contrapposto. The face is in three-quarter view - a small soft smile that hasn't formed all the way. The figure wears worn Levi's, a faded chambray work shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbows, a leather belt cinched at a worn notch, dusty boots. A wedding ring on the left hand is the only ornament. The porch boards beneath are silver with weather. To one side: a metal bucket with a few empty beer bottles, a guitar case leaned against a column, a ginger cat on the rail watching the same far point. The yard beyond is summer-burnt grass, an old pickup truck, a far row of pines, a thunderhead piling pink-and-grey on the horizon. Lighting is direct rake-light from a setting sun off-frame right, igniting the rim of the cheekbone and the smoke from a single cigarette held in the right hand. Mood: a long quiet that does not need explanation.

prompts.title: Reading in the Dryer
prompts.description: Folded impossibly into a laundromat dryer drum, book inches from face
prompts.descriptionRu: Невероятно сложился внутри барабана сушилки, книга у самого лица
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure sits in a coin-op laundromat dryer (door open, machine OFF) reading a paperback, captured frontally as if from a low chair across the room. The figure has folded himself impossibly into the dryer's cylindrical drum: knees drawn up against the chest, the back curved against the rear of the drum, head tilted to fit, the right hand holding the open paperback inches from the face, the left hand resting on a knee with one finger marking some other page. The face is composed and intent, lips moving slightly with what's being read, glasses sliding down the nose. The figure wears a thrifted Hawaiian shirt unbuttoned over a plain white tee, cargo shorts, mismatched socks, no shoes. The dryer's interior is the dull beige of well-loved appliance metal, dented and scorched in places, the lint-screen visible to one side. The viewer-side wall of the laundromat shows a row of front-load washers, a child's discarded sock on the floor, a vending machine glowing pale green with off-brand soda. A single basket of folded laundry sits beside the dryer with a balled-up pair of jeans on top. Lighting is the unforgiving overhead fluorescent flat tube, cold white, plus a faint warm orange spill from a streetlamp through the front window at frame-edge. Mood: complete claim of a small space.

prompts.title: Vespa Hillside Lean
prompts.description: Mid-corner on a mint Vespa above the Tyrrhenian Sea, suit and loafers
prompts.descriptionRu: В повороте на мятной Веспе над Тирренским морем, в костюме и лоферах
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration of a figure mid-corner on a vintage Vespa scooter on a narrow Italian hillside road at midmorning. Captured from a side tracking angle, the scooter and rider in profile mid-lean, a 25-degree tilt into the curve. The figure leans forward, both gloved hands on the handlebars, right wrist slightly twisted on the throttle, body braced through the knees against the scooter frame. The face is in profile under a tucked-down chin: sunglasses on, mouth set in a small focused smile, helmet absent (this is bad and very Italian). The figure wears a slim-cut grey suit jacket buttoned, a crisp white open-collar shirt, dark slim trousers, leather loafers, a leather messenger bag slung crosswise so it rides on the lower back. The Vespa is faded mint-green with a chrome leg shield, a single small dent in the front fender, a leather-strapped baguette and a bouquet of yellow chrysanthemums tucked into the rear rack basket. The road is a hot pale ribbon hugging the hillside; the inside of the curve drops to a terraced olive grove and a glimpse of blue Tyrrhenian sea far below. The outside of the curve is a low stone wall with bursts of bougainvillea spilling over. A single ochre farmhouse sits in the deeper distance. Lighting is hard mediterranean sun from screen-right, throwing a sharp diagonal shadow of scooter and rider across the road. Mood: the casual virtuosity of a commute.

prompts.title: Skatepark Kickflip
prompts.description: Frozen at the apex of a kickflip in a graffiti bowl, kid watching
prompts.descriptionRu: Замер на пике кикфлипа в граффити-чаше, мальчишка смотрит
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is captured from a low front angle, frozen mid-air at the apex of a skateboard kickflip on a graffiti-covered concrete bowl in a public skatepark. Both feet are off the deck, the board itself rotating sideways below the feet, body tucked, arms pinwheeling for balance with the right arm forward and the left arm cocked behind. The face is locked in a flat, focused expression - no smile yet, just the pre-decision instant of "did I land this." The figure wears a baggy white t-shirt that has lifted to expose two inches of stomach, loose-fit black jeans rolled at the cuff over high-top sneakers worn through at the toe, a black baseball cap turned slightly sideways. A small chain wallet trails a chain that has lifted away from the hip in the airborne moment. Behind the figure, the bowl wall is a riot of colored tags, smiley faces, and overlapping signatures; the lip of the bowl is rounded by years of grinds. Empty beer cans rest in one corner. A single small kid sits on the rim watching, wide-eyed. The sky above is flat overcast. Lighting is the diffused white of high-cloud, with the colors of the graffiti popping despite the soft light. Mood: the suspended instant in which a thousand failures have not yet decided to become a success.

prompts.title: Desert Convertible
prompts.description: One-finger hook on the wheel, toothpick smile, road to nowhere
prompts.descriptionRu: Один палец на руле, зубочистка в улыбке, дорога в никуда
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration of a figure driving a beat-up convertible muscle car on a long straight desert highway in the American Southwest, captured from the passenger seat looking sideways at the driver and out the windshield. The figure's left hand rests at the very bottom of the steering wheel in an effortless one-finger hook; the right hand is raised, elbow on the door sill, the back of the hand braced against the wind, fingertips drumming the door panel. The body is sunk low into the bucket seat, knees apart, posture pure unhurried. The face is in three-quarter - aviator sunglasses, a toothpick clamped in the corner of a small smile, hair wind-thrashed. The figure wears a sleeveless white tank top with a small tear at the collar, faded jeans, a leather belt with a small turquoise buckle, a single leather wrist-cord. Inside the car: cracked red leather seats, an open paper map blowing on the floorboard, an unopened bottle of warm cola in the center console, an analog radio glowing FM 88.1, a half-melted cassette case. The windshield reveals a road that runs perfectly straight to the horizon, telephone poles ticking by, mesa silhouettes in the deep distance, one circling vulture. The sky is a flat saturated cobalt with a single high cirrus. Lighting is harsh midday sun from the upper-right, glinting off the chrome of the rear-view mirror. Mood: the freedom of having absolutely nowhere to be by sundown.

prompts.title: Stream at First Light
prompts.description: Crouched in a mountain stream, cupped hands raising water to the mouth
prompts.descriptionRu: Присел в горном ручье, сложенные ладони с водой подносит к губам
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure crouches alone in a small mountain stream at first light, captured medium-shot from the opposite bank. The figure is in a low squat, balanced on weathered boulders, the water running fast around the boots. Both hands are cupped together, full of clear stream-water that catches the dawn; he is in the act of bringing the cupped palms to his mouth to drink. The face is bent forward, eyes closed, expression of small hard-earned reverence. Hair drips. The figure wears a flannel shirt rolled to the forearms, a dark canvas vest with a small fishing-fly pinned to the collar, faded khakis cuffed and wet to mid-shin, leather hiking boots laced tight. A bedroll and a rifle case lie in the foreground on a flat rock; an open metal mug rests beside them with steam still rising. The stream is brilliant glass-clear, broken silver where it folds over rocks; small black river-pebbles are visible underneath. The far bank is dense fir forest, mist clinging in the lower branches. Lighting is sidelong cold blue dawn from screen-left, with the first warm gold rim just beginning to catch the upper edge of the figure's hat brim. Mood: a man briefly equal to the world he's standing in. EFFECTS: dust particles in light beam, golden hour.

prompts.title: The Conspiracy Wall
prompts.description: Pinning photos and red string under a single bare bulb, one-man investigation
prompts.descriptionRu: Прикалывает фото и красную нить под голой лампочкой, расследование в одиночку
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure sits cross-legged on the floor in front of a wall covered in pinned photographs, news clippings, and red string in a small dim apartment, captured frontally medium-wide. The wall fills the background; the figure occupies the center foreground. Both hands are raised: the right hand pins a new photograph to the wall with a thumbtack mid-press, the left hand holds a spool of red string with a length already trailing toward another photo. The face is intent, half-lit, lips parted. The figure wears a rumpled white button-down shirt with the sleeves shoved up, dark trousers, no tie, suspenders hanging loose around the hips, a single shoe off. The wall is a chaotic collage: dozens of photographs (faces, places, license plates), printed maps, hand-scrawled notes on lined paper, a child's drawing in the bottom corner, three long ribbons of red string crisscrossing between thumbtacks like a constellation. A single overhead bulb on a black cord hangs above the figure casting a hard cone. On the floor: an upended tin of thumbtacks, an ashtray with one stubbed cigarette, a yellow legal pad covered in writing, a single mug long gone cold. Lighting is one source - the bare bulb - direct from above, deep raccoon shadows under the eyes, the rest of the room receding to charcoal. Mood: a one-man investigation that is becoming a religion. EFFECTS: handwritten notes overlay, redacted censored bars.

prompts.title: London Cab in Rain
prompts.description: Half-out of a black cab, hair slicked dark, caught and not caring
prompts.descriptionRu: Полу-выходя из чёрного кэба, мокрые волосы, пойман и не парится
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands inside a London black cab at the curb of a wet city street at night, half-out of the rear door which is held open above his head. Captured from across the street, the cab in profile with the figure caught in the act of stepping down. One foot is on the wet sidewalk; one foot is still inside the cab. The right hand grips the cab roof for balance; the left hand holds a worn leather folio against the hip. The face is turned three-quarter back to look directly at the camera with a flat, unsurprised expression - caught, not caring. The figure wears a long charcoal overcoat, a dove-grey three-piece suit, polished black brogues, no umbrella despite the rain - the hair is slicked dark and wet. The cab itself is the classic boxy black London hackney, headlamps glowing yellow, the meter visible through the side window with a number. Wet asphalt reflects the cab's red taillight in a long red smear. Behind, a Georgian terrace of white-stucco facades with black ironwork, a pillar-box red and beaded with rain, a single warm window above. The rain falls in vertical silver lines. Lighting is mixed cool - sodium streetlamp from the upper-right, cab's red taillight from below, occasional warm yellow from a passing window. Mood: an arrival the figure was not announcing. EFFECTS: rain, anamorphic flare.

prompts.title: Sawdust Workshop
prompts.description: Mid-cut at the table saw, sawdust ignited in a volumetric sun beam
prompts.descriptionRu: В процессе распила, опилки горят в объёмном солнечном луче
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is captured at eye-level inside a small woodworking workshop, mid-action at the table saw. Sawdust hangs in a slow gold cloud all around the figure, lit from a single high window. Both hands grip a long pine plank steady against the saw fence; the saw's spinning blade is a soft motion-blur disk in the immediate foreground. The figure leans forward into the cut, body braced through bent knees, weight on the front foot, head tilted just enough to track the line. The face is composed - safety glasses on, ear-defenders pushed up onto the crown, a small grim concentration to the mouth, a smear of sawdust frosting one eyebrow. The figure wears a heavy canvas shop apron over a chambray shirt and dark workpants, leather steel-toed boots, a carpenter's pencil tucked behind one ear, a tape measure clipped at the hip, two old plaster bandages on the left thumb. The shop around: walls of pegboard with chisels, hand-planes, clamps; a half-built chair on a workbench; coils of yellow extension cord; a transistor radio on a high shelf. A pinup calendar on the wall, the date crossed out in marker. Lighting is one huge window pouring volumetric sun from screen-right, every floating sawdust mote ignited; the shadow side of the figure deep cool umber. Mood: the meditative precision of a small good thing being made well. EFFECTS: dust particles in light beam, volumetric lighting.

sections.name: Solo · Female-coded
sections.description: 15 single female-coded figures, tender and theatrical
sections.descriptionRu: 15 одиночных женских фигур, нежных и театральных

prompts.title: Upside-Down on Monkey Bars
prompts.description: Suspended inverted at sunset playground, soda dripping, bored godliness
prompts.descriptionRu: Подвешена вниз головой на закатной площадке, газировка капает, скучающая божественность
prompts.body: SCENE: A vertical 9:16 illustration. A figure is suspended upside-down from monkey bars in an empty playground at sunset, knees hooked over the metal bar, body fully inverted. Hair hangs straight down, swaying. Both arms dangle loosely above the head (which is below). Face is upside-down to the viewer, with a small mischievous grin and eyes that are deliberately crossed. In the right hand, the figure holds an opened can of soda; a slow droplet of orange liquid is in the act of falling out of the can toward the woodchips below. The figure wears a pleated skirt that has flipped down toward the head, exposing dark cycling shorts underneath, a white blouse half-untucked, knee-high socks slipping. Background: empty municipal playground, faded blue plastic slide, a swing set with one swing creaking sideways, a chain-link fence with vines, a sky in deep magenta-orange gradient with a single contrail. Lighting is warm raking sidelight from the setting sun, kissing the metal of the bars with copper specular. Mood: bored and serenely upside-down godliness. EFFECTS: pen doodles overlay, lens flare. The doodles are blue ballpoint, sloppy and clearly self-applied: hearts with arrows along the figure's bare forearm, the words "BORED" scrawled vertically up the inside of one knee, three little stars near the ear, a tiny crooked smiley face on the back of one hand. The doodles read as drawn ON the photograph after printing - and on the figure herself before the photograph was taken.

prompts.title: Wheat Field at Noon
prompts.description: Waist-deep in wheat, palms up, bee suspended near her ear
prompts.descriptionRu: По пояс в пшенице, ладони вверх, пчела зависла у уха
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands waist-deep in a wheat field at high noon, captured from the chest up. The figure faces the camera, arms slightly raised and out to either side at hip-level, palms open and turned upward, fingers brushing the wheat tops. Eyes are closed, head tilted up to the sun, lips parted in a small contented smile. A bumblebee is suspended in mid-flight near the figure's right ear. The figure wears a sleeveless white linen sundress with eyelet trim, a thin gold chain at the neck, and a single woven grass bracelet on the right wrist. The wheat fills the entire midground in horizontal golden-amber waves, occasional poppies and cornflowers punctuating it. The background is a flat blue summer sky with a single small cumulus cloud directly above the figure's head, like a punctuation mark. Lighting is harsh directional overhead sun with bright bouncing fill from the wheat. The concept is the pagan quietness of being briefly forgotten by the world.

prompts.title: Trespass at the Pool
prompts.description: Hip-deep at the center of a still indoor pool at night, palms on water
prompts.descriptionRu: По пояс в неподвижном крытом бассейне ночью, ладони на воде
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration of a figure standing in the very center of a perfectly still indoor swimming pool at night, water at hip level. The pool is institutional turquoise tile, the lane lines have been removed. The figure faces directly forward, body symmetrical, both arms slightly out from the sides with palms resting on the water surface, fingers spread. The head is tilted slightly down, eyes lifted in a steady upward gaze toward the camera, expression unreadable, lips closed. The figure wears a one-piece black swimsuit with a high neck. The pool's surface is mirror-still except for tiny concentric ripples spreading from the fingertips, and a single fallen leaf floating at the far edge. Above and around: an empty natatorium with rows of dark windows, ceiling fluorescents OFF, the only light coming from the underwater pool lamps casting upward-rippled cyan reflections across the white tile walls and the figure's face. The figure's reflection is shattered by the gentle ripples. Mood: late-night sacred trespass. NEGATIVE: visible feet through the water (water should be opaque turquoise under reflection).

prompts.title: Bookshop Ladder
prompts.description: On tiptoe reaching the top shelf, one shoe already fallen below
prompts.descriptionRu: На цыпочках тянется к верхней полке, один ботинок уже упал
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands on a stepladder in a small bookshop, reaching up. Wide vertical shot. The figure is on tiptoe on the third rung, body fully extended upward in a long S-curve, the right arm straight up with fingertips just brushing the spine of a book on the very top shelf. The left hand grips the top of the ladder for balance. The figure's face is tilted up, mouth set in a stubborn pout of concentration, brows furrowed. The figure wears a brown librarian's cardigan, a pleated mid-length skirt, opaque tights, and one shoe - the other shoe has fallen onto the floor below. The bookshop is dense, floor-to-ceiling: walnut shelves bowed in the middle, books stacked horizontally on top of vertical rows, a globe on the floor, a sleeping bookshop dog curled by the ladder, a hanging brass lamp with a green glass shade. A small rolling cart in the foreground holds open volumes face-down. Lighting is warm tungsten from the brass lamp combined with cool daylight from a single round porthole window above the upper shelves, creating a vertical light column on the figure's reaching arm. The concept is the precise instant before retrieval. EFFECTS: sketch lines overlay, soft focus. The sketch lines are graphite construction marks: a faint perspective grid running back into the shelves' vanishing point, an arrow labeled "TARGET" pointing at the top-shelf book, a small note in the margin reading "do not fall again", and a single eraser-smudge cloud at the corner. The drawings read as a librarian's working notebook accidentally laid over the image.

prompts.title: 4 A.M. Shawarma
prompts.description: Post-club sacrament at a kiosk under fluorescent buzz, smudged mascara
prompts.descriptionRu: Постклубное таинство у ларька под жужжанием ламп, размазанная тушь
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands at a 24-hour shawarma kiosk under a single buzzing fluorescent tube at 4 a.m. Wide medium shot. The figure leans both forearms on the kiosk's chrome counter, body bowed forward in surrender to the smell, both hands cradling a freshly-wrapped foil shawarma like a holy relic. The first bite has been taken - sauce drips threaten to fall on the counter. The figure's eyes are closed in beatific transcendence, mouth full mid-chew, eyebrows climbing in disbelief at how good. The figure wears a sequined party top now wrinkled and a long unbuttoned coat, mascara slightly smudged, a single dangling earring, mismatched shoes. Behind the kiosk window: the kiosk worker stoic in a paper hat, a vertical rotating spit, racks of sauces, a tiny TV playing static. The street beyond is a dim Eastern European night, a tram cable swooping overhead, a flickering pharmacy cross sign in the distance, wet cobblestones reflecting neon orange. Lighting is harsh fluorescent overhead with a kicker from the pharmacy neon. Mood: post-club sacrament. EFFECTS: crumpled paper texture overlay, chromatic aberration.

prompts.title: Bioluminescent Yacht Dance
prompts.description: Mid-spin on deck, silk dress and glowing plankton spray, Milky Way above
prompts.descriptionRu: В развороте на палубе, шёлковое платье и брызги планктона, Млечный Путь сверху
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration of a figure on a yacht-deck at night, captured mid-action from a low angle. The figure is balanced on the polished teak deck mid-spin in a barefoot dance, body arched in a long C, both arms thrown wide, head thrown back, eyes closed, mouth in an open laugh. A long silk dress in deep ocean-blue swirls in a perfect circle around the legs, hem crackling with bioluminescent plankton spray that has somehow leapt onto the fabric. The right hand holds a half-empty crystal champagne flute, the liquid suspended mid-tilt about to spill. The left hand trails behind clutching nothing. Around the deck: scattered rope coils, a brass ship's bell, a single open book of poetry blown facedown. The yacht is small and old, weathered. Beyond the deck: black sea, blacker sky, the entire visible water aglow with the faint cyan trail of bioluminescent algae stirred by the boat's wake. The Milky Way is brutal overhead. Lighting comes only from the algae below and the stars above, casting two competing blue washes on the figure. Mood: oceanic ecstatic loneliness. EFFECTS: bokeh, light leak.

prompts.title: Dance Studio Stretch
prompts.description: Folded in half on hardwood, mirror doubling the entire scene
prompts.descriptionRu: Сложилась пополам на паркете, зеркало удваивает всю сцену
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is seated cross-legged on a bare hardwood floor of an empty dance studio, viewed from a low corner of the room. The far wall is a floor-to-ceiling mirror; the figure's reflection sits parallel, identical pose, mirrored. The figure is in tights and a leotard, wears soft pink ballet slippers, hair in a tight bun. The body is collapsed forward over the legs in a deep stretch, forehead almost touching shins, both hands wrapped around the soles of the feet. The face is hidden by hair. A pair of pointe shoes lies on the floor beside the figure with their satin ribbons trailing in a careful spiral. A water bottle stands tall a few feet away. The mirrored wall doubles the entire scene; the wood floor's grain forms a perfect symmetry meeting at the mirror line. A barre runs along the mirror wall, casting a single horizontal line. Lighting is one cold north-facing window pouring even pale blue from the side, no other sources. Mood: solitary discipline before performance. NEGATIVE: incorrect mirror reflection (must perfectly match the original figure pose).

prompts.title: Tub of Rubber Ducks
prompts.description: Balanced on the tub's rim above thousands of yellow ducks, frozen guilt
prompts.descriptionRu: Балансирует на бортике над тысячами жёлтых уточек, замершая вина
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure crouched on the rim of a bathtub in an empty pastel-tile bathroom, captured from the front at a low diagonal. The bathtub is filled with thousands of tiny rubber ducks. The figure balances precariously on the tub's rim, both feet bare, knees deeply bent, body tipped forward, both arms held wide for balance like a high-wire walker. Eyes are wide and fixed straight at the camera with a frozen "what have I done" expression. The figure wears short pajamas with cherry print, hair in two messy buns. One yellow rubber duck is balanced on top of the head. A second duck is wedged in the crook of the right elbow. Three ducks are still mid-air around the figure as if they'd just been thrown in. The bathroom is pale mint-green tile, a small basket of bath towels on a stool, a frosted window admitting flat morning light. Lighting is even pale blue daylight with soft yellow bouncing off the duck-pile. Mood: domestic moral panic. EFFECTS: sticker collage overlay, soft focus.

prompts.title: Abandoned Pool Cathedral
prompts.description: At the bottom of a drained tile pool, god-rays through skylights
prompts.descriptionRu: На дне пустого кафельного бассейна, лучи света сквозь разбитые окна
prompts.body: SCENE: A wide-angle illustration of a figure inside a dim, cathedral-sized vintage indoor pool - abandoned, drained, dust-floored. The figure is centered at the bottom of the deep end, looking up the long sloped tile floor toward the camera positioned at the shallow-end edge. The figure stands with both arms hanging loose, palms open slightly forward, head tilted up in awe to the shafts of sunlight cutting down from broken skylights overhead. A flock of disturbed pigeons flutters across one of the light-shafts, casting moving shadow across the figure's upturned face. The figure wears a long black dress and a single dust-print on the cheek. The empty pool's tiles are ornate art-nouveau peacock motifs in faded turquoise and gold, water-stained. Cracked plaster columns, peeling diving board, a rusted ladder bent at an angle. Lighting is sharp cathedral god-rays through dust, isolating the figure in a halo. Mood: reverence for the corpse of a glorious place.

prompts.title: Lipstick in the Vestibule
prompts.description: Two mirrors at once, judgmental cat, leaving with maximum drama
prompts.descriptionRu: Два зеркала сразу, осуждающий кот, выходит с максимальной драмой
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands in front of a Soviet-era hallway mirror inside a poorly-lit communal apartment vestibule. Captured frontally; we see both the figure and the figure's reflection. The figure faces the mirror, body squared, both hands raised - the right hand is in the act of finishing the last loop of bright crimson lipstick on the lips, while the left hand holds a tiny plastic compact mirror up to the side as if double-checking. The face in the wall mirror is sharp-eyed and amused; the face in the small compact mirror is at a different angle and shows the lipstick mid-application. The figure wears a tan trench coat over a dressing-gown - clearly leaving in a hurry. A house cat sits on a wooden stool beneath the mirror, watching with profound judgment. Around: a coat rack overloaded with three coats and a fur shapka, communal mailboxes along the wall with peeling numbers, cracked floor tile, a wallpaper of faded brown vines. The mirror frame is ornate dark wood. Lighting is one sad yellow bulb above the mirror, with a slice of cooler daylight from a half-open door at the edge of the frame. Mood: leaving the apartment with maximum drama for a very small errand.

prompts.title: Photo-Booth Strip
prompts.description: Four panels of chaos arcing into one tender sincere smile
prompts.descriptionRu: Четыре панели хаоса перетекают в одну искреннюю улыбку
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is captured in a close-up at an old-school photo-booth strip, four panels visible vertically. In each panel the figure does something different. Top panel: figure makes a peace sign and grins teeth-baring at the camera. Second panel: figure has slid down out of frame, only the top of the head and two waving hands above the frame edge. Third panel: figure has popped back up, eyes crossed, tongue out, holding a vintage candy lollipop pressed to the cheek. Fourth panel: figure leans elbows on the seat, chin in hands, gives the camera a soft sincere closed-mouth smile, eyes warm. The booth's curtain is visible at the edges in deep crimson velvet. The figure wears a striped sailor shirt and a single butterfly clip in the hair (different position in each panel because of the chaos). Lighting is the booth's harsh on-camera flash with cool fluorescent fill. Mood: a complete character arc in four square inches. EFFECTS: crayon drawing overlay, polaroid frame. The crayon overlay is in waxy primary colors, drawn by what is clearly a child or a very excited adult: a bright purple heart around panel three, a yellow sun in the corner of panel one, the words "BEST DAY" scrawled in red across the bottom of all four frames, a tiny green snake winding between the panels. The drawings sit ON the photo strip itself, smudged where a thumb has touched.

prompts.title: Fire-Escape in Sequins
prompts.description: Dangling from a fifth-floor ladder in a ridiculous evening gown
prompts.descriptionRu: Висит на лестнице пятого этажа в нелепом вечернем платье
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure dangles from a fire escape outside a fifth-floor brick apartment building, captured from below in a very low-angle wide shot. The figure hangs by both hands from the bottom rung of the fire escape ladder, body fully extended, legs kicking lightly, looking down toward the camera with an exasperated half-grin: "well, this is fine." The figure wears a ridiculous floor-length sequined evening gown that is bunched up around the thighs from the wind, paired with practical sneakers. A small purse swings from the right wrist. The fire escape is rust-streaked iron, with one window above showing a cat watching impassively from the sill. Below the figure, a narrow alley with steaming manhole cover, a dumpster, the corner of a neon SUSHI sign. The brick wall is plastered with peeling paste-up posters. Lighting is warm orange sodium streetlamp from the alley below mixed with a bluer ambient from above. Mood: dressed for a different evening's plan.

prompts.title: Museum Tomb Effigy
prompts.description: Playing dead on marble among Roman busts, lily on the chest
prompts.descriptionRu: Изображает мертвую на мраморе среди римских бюстов, лилия на груди
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure lies on the cold marble floor of a museum's classical sculpture hall, on their back, hands folded across the chest, in a deliberate parody of a tomb effigy. Captured from an overhead high-angle. The figure is completely still, eyes closed, a serene mock-pious expression, a single white lily clutched in the folded hands. The figure wears all black with a long flowing skirt. Around them, the marble hall stretches in deep perspective: rows of headless Roman busts on plinths, a colossal seated statue at the far end, a fluted column in the corner, a single museum guard far in the deep background looking the other way. The marble floor is patterned in geometric grey-and-cream. A small velvet rope cordon is visible just past the figure's feet. Lighting is the cold bluish daylight of museum skylights, even and shadowless. Mood: theatrical solemnity at the wrong moment. NEGATIVE: museum guard noticing. EFFECTS: dust particles in light beam, sepia tone.

prompts.title: Four-Leaf Clover
prompts.description: Flat on the back in clover, four-leaf raised to the sky, bumblebee above
prompts.descriptionRu: Лежит навзничь в клевере, четырёхлистник поднят к небу, шмель сверху
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is captured at a worm's-eye low angle, lying flat on the back in a meadow of clover, arms and legs spread, looking straight up. The camera sits on the ground a meter from the figure's head. Above the figure, the sky is perfectly framed by a giant tree's spreading canopy. The figure's eyes are wide open, pupils enormous, a small slack-jawed wonder on the face. A four-leaf clover is held up in the right hand toward the sky as if to compare. A single bumblebee is suspended above the nose. The figure wears a long flowing white sundress, straw hat fallen aside, bare feet. The clover bed is dense and bright green, dotted with yellow buttercups. The tree's leaves above are silvered on the underside in a breeze, a few pale petals drifting down. A patch of cobalt sky shows between the highest branches. Lighting is dappled green-gold filtered light, rim-bright at the edges of every leaf above. Mood: reverence for cheap miracles.

prompts.title: Giant Sunflower Awe
prompts.description: Waist-deep in sunflowers taller than her, awed by one giant bloom
prompts.descriptionRu: По пояс в подсолнухах выше неё, в благоговении перед огромным цветком
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands waist-deep in a sea of long-stemmed sunflowers at the very tail of summer, captured medium-wide. The flowers are TALLER than the figure, towering above the head; the figure stands inside the field with neck craned upward at a particularly enormous bloom directly over the head. Both hands are raised to gently steady the heavy nodding flower's stem at face level. The face is tilted up, eyes locked on the giant black-and-gold disk above, mouth slightly open in awe. The figure wears a faded yellow sundress and a wide straw hat tipped back. Bees move slowly between the flowers. Distant glimpses of more sunflowers stretching to a dark windbreak of poplars. The sky above is huge and pale blue with high cirrus brushed in long strokes. Lighting is direct hot midday sun, flowers and figure all golden. Mood: standing in a temple no one built. EFFECTS: falling petals overlay, golden hour.

sections.name: Solo · Universal
sections.description: 37 gender-neutral single-figure scenes across moods and places
sections.descriptionRu: 37 гендерно-нейтральных сцен с одной фигурой, разные настроения и места

prompts.title: Snow Angel from Above
prompts.description: Overhead view, spread-eagle in fresh powder, breath plume rising
prompts.descriptionRu: Вид сверху, раскинулся в свежем снегу, столб дыхания поднимается
prompts.body: SCENE: Overhead bird's-eye view. A figure is captured directly from above, lying spread-eagle on freshly fallen snow that fills the entire frame, arms and legs sweeping outward to make a snow angel. The figure's head is tilted back into the powder, eyes screwed shut, mouth wide open in an unrestrained laugh, breath rising in a visible white plume that almost reaches the camera. Hair fans out around the head in a dark halo against the white. Both gloved hands are mid-sweep, the right slightly higher than the left, leaving fan-shaped trails in the snow. The figure wears a thick puffer coat the color of egg yolk, navy snow pants, and one mitten that has come loose and rests near the wrist. Surrounding the angel-form is virgin powder, dotted with three small pinecones and a scatter of pine needles. At the corners of the frame, the dark green of conifer branches creeps in. Lighting is diffused white-blue overcast winter light with a faintest pink suggesting late afternoon. The concept is solitary unfiltered joy. NEGATIVE: footprints leading away from the figure (there should be none on this side).

prompts.title: 2 A.M. Laundromat Selfie
prompts.description: Cheek squished against laundromat glass, collapsing peace sign
prompts.descriptionRu: Щека прижата к стеклу прачечной, ослабевший знак мира
prompts.body: SCENE: Selfie. Front-camera. A figure leans against the sticker-covered glass door of a 24-hour laundromat, holding the phone at arm's length so half the laundromat is visible behind. The figure is tilted slightly, head cocked, with one cheek squished against the cold glass. The right hand holds the phone; the left hand is raised in a half-hearted peace sign that's collapsing into a wave. Eyes are tired but smiling, with one eyelid slightly heavier than the other. The figure wears an oversized hoodie pulled up halfway, pajama pants under it, and slippers. Behind the figure: rows of washers in chrome and white, a single tumbling drum mid-cycle blurring its colors, a vending machine glowing pale green, a flickering fluorescent tube overhead, and a stranger far in the back reading a newspaper. Lighting is unforgiving fluorescent flat with the screen's own warm reflected glow on the figure's face. The mood is 2 a.m. domestic exile. Slight motion blur on the spinning drum. EFFECTS: scan lines overlay, cool tones.

prompts.title: Tide Pool Reverence
prompts.description: Kneeling at a tide pool, chin in cupped hands, starfish in the water
prompts.descriptionRu: Стоит на коленях у заводи, подбородок в ладонях, морская звезда в воде
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration with a wide 16:9 aspect ratio. A figure kneels at the edge of a tide pool at low tide, body in a low crouch, weight resting on the right knee with the left foot flat on wet rock. The figure leans forward, both elbows on the front knee, chin cupped in both palms, gazing down into the pool with an absorbed expression of total scientific reverence. Long hair falls forward, the wet ends nearly touching the water's surface. The figure wears a knit fisherman's sweater rolled at the cuffs and rolled-up linen trousers; bare feet are wet and barnacle-pricked. The pool itself is a microcosm: a single small orange starfish, three transparent shrimp, a rust-red sea anemone open like a flower, three tiny periwinkle snails, and the figure's own face rippling on the surface. Around the pool, the rocks are streaked with white salt crust and black mussel clusters. The background is a wide low-tide flat receding to a slate-grey sea under a heavy mother-of-pearl sky. Lighting is soft, overcast, with the water acting as a pale silver mirror. The mood is hushed pre-storm wonder.

prompts.title: Dandelion Sneeze
prompts.description: Pre-sneeze macro, single dandelion seed suspended at the lip
prompts.descriptionRu: Макро перед чихом, семя одуванчика подвешено у губы
prompts.body: SCENE: Macro close-up. A figure's face fills the right two-thirds of the frame, viewed from a 3/4 angle. The figure is about to sneeze: nose scrunched, eyes fully shut, eyebrows knitted, mouth half-open in the inhalation just before the explosion. A single fluffy white dandelion seed is suspended in mid-air a centimeter from the upper lip. The figure's right hand is raised partway to the face but won't make it in time, fingers half-curled. A field of dandelions, fully gone-to-seed, blurs into a creamy white-green bokeh background. Lighting is direct golden-hour sun from screen-left, igniting the floating seed and outlining a downy halo on the cheek and earlobe. The concept is the universe pranking a pollen-allergic person at the loveliest possible moment. NEGATIVE: seed already inside the nostril.

prompts.title: Hotel Hallway Mask
prompts.description: Tiny at the vanishing point, blank plastic mask, dread without violence
prompts.descriptionRu: Крошечный в точке схода, гладкая пластиковая маска, тихий ужас
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands in an empty hotel hallway at the end of a long corridor. Worm's-eye low-angle perspective. The carpet is a gaudy red-and-gold geometric pattern that fills the foreground, leading to the figure who is centered at the vanishing point. The figure is small in the frame, both arms held perfectly straight at the sides, body rigid, face entirely hidden by a clear plastic mask of blank smooth features tied with a black ribbon. Head is tilted unnaturally forward five degrees too far. Identical doors line both walls in a one-point perspective march, all closed, brass numbers on each. A single brass wall sconce on each wall casts a small warm pool of light at every fourth door, leaving the spaces between in muted shadow. The figure wears a long unstructured grey nightgown that grazes the carpet. Lighting is dim incandescent yellow with deep red-shifted shadows. The mood is dread without violence. NEGATIVE: open doors; visible face under the mask. EFFECTS: vignette, fog.

prompts.title: Thrift Store Melodrama
prompts.description: Sprawled on a velvet chaise, theatrical despair amid donations
prompts.descriptionRu: Разлёгся на бархатной кушетке, театральное отчаяние среди вещей
prompts.body: SCENE: Dutch angle. A figure is collapsed sideways across a velvet chaise lounge in a thrift store, surrounded on all sides by towers of unsorted donations. The figure is sprawled on the back, one arm flung over the eyes in mock theatrical despair, the other arm dangling off the chaise with a vintage Polaroid camera dangling from a wrist strap, swinging gently. One leg is on the chaise; the other has slid off and rests on a stack of paperback books, foot in a lace-up boot. A wide-brimmed straw hat with a half-eaten silk rose has slid off the head and rests on the floor. Surrounding the chaise: a headless mannequin in a faux-fur stole, a brass floor lamp shaped like a flamingo, a portrait of a stranger's grandmother in an oval frame, a glass case of broken costume jewelry, and a cat-shaped clock with the tail wagging seconds. Lighting is filtered through a yellowed plastic skylight, hazy and warm with floating dust. The mood is overwhelmed-treasure-hunter melodrama.

prompts.title: Head in the Freezer
prompts.description: Heatwave coping, head buried in freezer fog, frost-vapor halo
prompts.descriptionRu: Спасение от жары, голова в морозильном тумане, нимб из инея
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure crouches in front of a refrigerator covered in magnets and children's drawings in a small Eastern European apartment. The figure is shot from the side at hip level, body in a deep squat, knees hugged to chest. The right hand holds open the freezer door at the very top; the left hand is buried inside the freezer fog, presumably gripping something. The face is leaned into the freezer compartment, eyes closed, expression of ecstatic relief, hair lifting slightly in the cold-air draft. A halo of white frost-vapor curls out around the head. The figure wears a sweat-damp tank top and pajama shorts, ankle socks pushed down. Above the freezer door, an upper magnet display: a Crimean magnet, an Eiffel Tower magnet, a mosaic-tile magnet from Lisbon, and a child's crayon drawing of a yellow sun with a face. The kitchen behind is summer-stifling: a fan blurring on a stool, an empty glass on the floor with a melting ice cube, sweat-drips of condensation on the linoleum. Lighting is hot orange evening sun slanting through a window blind in horizontal stripes across the figure's back. The concept is heatwave coping.

prompts.title: Winter Rooftop Edge
prompts.description: At the parapet at dusk, breath visible, city dimming below
prompts.descriptionRu: У парапета в сумерках, дыхание видно, город тускнеет внизу
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration of a figure on the rooftop of an apartment block in winter, captured from a low-angle three-quarter perspective at dusk. The figure stands at the edge of a flat tar roof, framed against a deep cobalt sky. The figure is mid-throw: the body is twisted in a wind-up, right arm cocked back behind the shoulder, left arm pointing forward as a counterweight aim, knees bent. The right hand holds a paper airplane folded from a printed letter, with visible typed text. The face is intent, tongue caught at the corner of the mouth, eyes locked on a destination far beyond the frame. The figure wears a knee-length wool coat unbuttoned, a chunky knit scarf wrapped twice, fingerless gloves. On the rooftop foreground: a satellite dish with snow gathered on its rim, a metal vent issuing a small white plume, a string of forgotten holiday lights tangled along the parapet. The background skyline is a sea of identical apartment blocks with a thousand warm yellow window-squares, a half-frozen river snaking through, and a single low pink star. Lighting is steel-blue dusk with one warm sodium spill from a stairwell door behind the figure. The mood is a goodbye that wants to be heard by the city. EFFECTS: handwritten notes overlay, blue hour. The handwriting is fast cursive in black fountain-pen ink, scrawled across the sky and the rooftops in fragmentary phrases - "I tried", "you weren't here", "they painted over the green door", "August again" - written by the figure on the airplane itself before it was thrown, and now leaking off the page into the world.

prompts.title: Through the Fishbowl
prompts.description: Face refracted through goldfish water, kitchen warped behind
prompts.descriptionRu: Лицо преломлено сквозь воду с золотыми рыбками, кухня искажена позади
prompts.body: SCENE: A close-up illustration of a figure, shot through the inside of a fishbowl. The fishbowl is large, round, on a kitchen table. The figure is on the far side of the bowl, face pressed close to the curved glass, distorted by the lensing of the water and glass into a wide-eyed caricature: enormous owlish eyes, narrowed forehead, cheeks flattened sideways. The mouth is open in a perfect "O" of conversation; the figure is clearly talking to the goldfish. A single goldfish hovers in the middle of the bowl, its body in sharp focus, mouth opening and closing in apparent reply. Bubbles rise behind it. The figure's right hand is raised on the far side of the glass, distorted finger pointing at something the fish can't possibly see. Behind the figure, blurred: a sunlit kitchen window with pale yellow curtains. Lighting is warm afternoon light filtering through the water, casting a wobbling caustic pattern on the figure's face and the table. The mood is patient one-sided friendship.

prompts.title: Zorb Down the Hill
prompts.description: Mid-roll inside a translucent orb on a grassy slope, all chaos
prompts.descriptionRu: Катится внутри прозрачного шара по травяному склону, сплошной хаос
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure sits inside a giant translucent inflatable orb (zorb ball), captured in a wide outdoor shot with the orb mid-roll down a grassy hillside. The figure is mid-tumble inside, body curled defensively with arms wrapped around shins, head ducked between knees, hair flying upward in zero-gravity disarray. The face shows pure laughing terror, mouth wide open, eyes squeezed shut. The interior of the orb is webbed with air-cushion ribs that distort the figure's silhouette. The figure wears bright pink athletic shorts and a yellow t-shirt, one sneaker has come off and is rolling beside the body inside the ball. Outside the orb: a long green grass slope receding into a small mountain town with red roofs at the bottom, a flock of sheep scattered to the sides like exclamation marks, blue sky with cumulus, lens flare from the upper-left sun. The orb has rolled tracks behind it and a small disturbed bee swarm rising in the wake. Lighting is bright midday with strong rim through the translucent plastic. Mood: physical-comedy euphoria. NEGATIVE: visible zipper of the orb (it must look seamless). EFFECTS: motion blur, lens flare.

prompts.title: Orchard Swing
prompts.description: Low-angle on a creaky swing in autumn, ropes climbing into branches
prompts.descriptionRu: Нижний ракурс на скрипучих качелях осенью, верёвки в ветвях
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure sits on a creaky wooden swing in an unkempt orchard at the edge of autumn. The shot is low-angle from the ground, looking up. The swing's two ropes climb diagonally out of the frame. The figure is in a relaxed slump, both knees together and slightly to one side, both hands gripping the ropes loosely. The head is tipped back against the rope, throat exposed, eyes closed, lips quirked in a private half-smile as if hearing a joke. A single red apple is balanced precariously on the figure's lap. Above and around: a canopy of half-bare apple branches, half the leaves yellow and the other half clinging green, scattered pale pink-white late blossoms confused by the season. Three apples hang at different heights. The sky beyond the branches is a high pale washed blue. On the ground far below, a basket already half-full of apples and one dozing tabby cat curled inside it. Lighting is flat soft mid-morning with warm patches reaching through gaps in the canopy. The mood is contented suspension between two seasons.

prompts.title: Clawfoot Bubble Bath
prompts.description: Bolt-upright in iridescent bubbles, knees barely surfacing
prompts.descriptionRu: Сидит прямо в радужной пене, колени едва над поверхностью
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration in 1:1 square aspect ratio. A figure sits bolt-upright in a clawfoot bathtub filled to the brim with iridescent soap bubbles, captured from the front. Bubbles rise above the figure's shoulders and trail down the chin and hair like a foam beard. The figure has fashioned a peaked bubble-crown atop the head and a bubble-monocle around the right eye. The right hand is raised aristocratically with a long-handled wooden bath brush held like a scepter; the left hand rests on the rim of the tub gripping a steaming porcelain teacup. The face is composed in a deeply serious, mock-imperial expression with eyebrows raised, mouth set in a tiny pursed line. In the background, a tiled bathroom wall in dusty turquoise hexagons, a frosted window admitting pale blue light, a brass faucet dripping a single suspended droplet, a rubber duck tilted as if bowing on the rim of the tub. Steam curls upward and condenses on the mirror in the corner where part of the figure's nonsense is reflected. Lighting is soft cool morning blue with the bubbles refracting tiny rainbows across the ceiling. Mood: solo dignified silliness. EFFECTS: rainbow prism overlay, soft focus.

prompts.title: Pottery Studio Selfie
prompts.description: Half-turned at the wheel, clay-streaked apron, tripod-mounted phone
prompts.descriptionRu: Полуобернулась за кругом, фартук в глине, телефон на штативе
prompts.body: SCENE: Selfie. A figure has propped a phone on a tripod inside a pottery studio and is half-turned mid-task. Captured at a 3/4 angle with the figure off-center to the right of the frame. Both hands are wet with grey clay; the right hand cradles a half-formed bowl spinning on a wheel; the left hand is raised away from the wheel, index finger and thumb pinched together in a "wait, picture first" gesture toward the camera. There is a gray clay handprint smeared across the figure's left cheek and another on the apron. The figure wears a navy denim apron over a tank top, hair wrapped in a bandana, one streak of clay arcing from forehead to ear. Eyes are bright, mouth in a teeth-baring laugh. The wheel kicks up a faint fine spray. Behind the figure: shelves lined with greenware bowls in various stages, glaze buckets in deep colors, a wall of hanging tools, a single window pouring warm afternoon light onto the right side of the figure's face. The wheel-thrown bowl is slightly off-center and probably ruined. Mood: messy uninterrupted joy. Slight depth-of-field with the wheel sharp and shelves softly blurred.

prompts.title: Walking Down the Jetway
prompts.description: Silhouetted from behind walking into the open mouth of a jet
prompts.descriptionRu: Силуэт сзади, идёт в открытое жерло трапа самолёта
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is captured from directly behind, walking away from the camera down the center of a wet airport jetway. The figure is silhouetted against the open mouth of the jetway where it meets the airplane door. Body weight is on the left foot, the right foot mid-stride, suitcase wheels rolling behind on the right and casting a thin water-trail on the rubber jetway flooring. The right hand pulls the suitcase; the left hand grips a wilting bouquet of supermarket tulips upside-down by the stems, three petals already fallen along the path behind the figure like a Hansel-trail. The head is tilted slightly to the right, hair caught mid-toss. The figure wears a long dark trenchcoat over jeans. Through the open airplane door at the far end, a slice of cabin interior glows warm amber, a crew member's silhouette frozen in greeting. Lighting is the cold corrugated fluorescents of the jetway against the warm cabin glow, splitting the figure into two color zones. Mood: a leaving that hasn't decided yet whether it's permanent. NEGATIVE: petals scattered ahead of the figure (they only fall behind).

prompts.title: Night Greenhouse Profile
prompts.description: Face pressed to glass at night, indoor jungle behind
prompts.descriptionRu: Лицо прижато к стеклу ночью, тропический сад за спиной
prompts.body: SCENE: A close-up portrait of a figure in a dimly lit greenhouse at night, captured at three-quarter angle. The figure's face is pressed in profile against the glass wall of an enormous fern terrarium that's almost the figure's height. The cheek is squashed flat, one eye visible peering inward, lips parted in awe. Inside the terrarium, a tiny cluster of bioluminescent mushrooms glows soft cyan, illuminating the figure's eye and cheekbone with cold light. The right hand is splayed flat on the glass at face height, fingertips pale where they press. The left hand holds a small notebook open with a pen tucked in the spine. The figure wears wire-rimmed glasses pushed up on the head, a thick green knit sweater, a leather satchel slung across the chest. Behind the figure: a botanical greenhouse interior with hanging baskets in shadow, a long wooden potting bench, and far in the back the warm yellow square of an overseer's office window. Lighting is pure mushroom-cyan on the figure's face plus a distant warm yellow rim from the office. Mood: scientific tender obsession.

prompts.title: Box-Stack in Empty Room
prompts.description: Crouched on a single tower of moving boxes in vast white room
prompts.descriptionRu: Присел на одной башне из коробок в огромной белой комнате
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure crouches on a stack of moving boxes in an empty white-walled apartment, only one box high in the otherwise vast empty room. Wide shot, deep one-point perspective with the figure dead-center. Both forearms rest on the figure's knees, hands hanging limp, fingertips touching. The figure stares directly at the camera with a flat, exhausted, unreadable expression - not sad, not happy, completely emptied out. The figure wears paint-stained overalls, a faded t-shirt, hair scraped into a messy bun with strands escaping. The boxes are labeled in marker: "KITCHEN", "BOOKS - DO NOT DROP", "MISC + FRAGILE", "??". A single houseplant sits on the floor far to the right, a pizza box closed on the floor to the left, a forgotten roll of packing tape unspooling. The walls bear pale rectangles where art used to hang. Lighting is the cold flat overhead light of a ceiling fixture without a shade - bare bulb. The figure's shadow is short and severe. Mood: the limbo between two homes. EFFECTS: marker highlights overlay, high contrast. The marker overlay is yellow highlighter applied to the cardboard box labels in the scene - only the words "FRAGILE", "DO NOT", and "??" glow yellow as if someone has tried to study a moving day for a test, while the rest of the image is left flat.

prompts.title: Hot Spring at Night
prompts.description: Floating in milky water, only head and limbs surfacing, stars above
prompts.descriptionRu: Плывёт в молочной воде, только голова и конечности на поверхности, звёзды сверху
prompts.body: SCENE: An overhead shot looking straight down at a figure floating on the back in a hot spring at night. The water is opaque pale milky blue, only the head, hands, knees, and tips of toes break the surface. The figure's eyes are closed, mouth in a small soft smile, hair fanning out in a dark anemone halo. Both hands float palms-up at hip level, fingers loose. A small wooden float-tray drifts beside the right hand carrying a single steaming sake cup and a folded paper crane. Around the figure, the milky water is dotted with stars - a perfect mirror reflection of the night sky overhead, but inverted: the brightest star is just below the chin. Wisps of steam curl up off the water in spirals. Surrounding the spring, the rim is rough volcanic black stone with a few patches of frost-edged moss. Lighting is starlight only; pale blue diffuse, with two distant warm lantern points at the corners of the frame. Mood: weightless union with sky.

prompts.title: Phone Booth in Neon Rain
prompts.description: Inside a fogged booth on a soaked neon street, receiver to ear
prompts.descriptionRu: Внутри запотевшей будки на залитой неоном улице, трубка у уха
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands inside a phone booth at the corner of a deserted neon-soaked street in heavy rain. The booth's glass is fogged with breath and rain. The figure is in profile, the right shoulder pressed to one glass wall, the receiver of an old corded payphone held to the ear with the right hand, the cord stretched taut. The left hand is splayed flat on the opposite glass wall, fingers spread, condensation around them. The face is half-turned toward the camera - visible through the fogged glass and trickling water lines - eyes wide, mouth slightly open as if about to say a word never said. The figure wears a soaked dark coat with the collar turned up. Outside the booth: rain in horizontal sheets, a wet sidewalk reflecting magenta and electric-cyan signage from across the street, a single pedestrian-shaped silhouette far down the block under a yellow umbrella, a small abandoned bouquet of pink carnations in the gutter. Lighting is mixed neon - magenta key on the side of the face, cyan rim along the back, warm interior bulb of the booth tinting the breath-fog gold. Mood: a confession to a number that won't pick up.

prompts.title: Dune Under Meteor Shower
prompts.description: Kneeling at the crest of a dune, sky streaked with falling stars
prompts.descriptionRu: На коленях на гребне дюны, небо исчёркано падающими звёздами
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is centered in a wide horizontal frame, kneeling at the edge of a desert dune at the absolute peak of a meteor shower. The figure faces away from the camera, kneeling upright with the back perfectly straight, head tilted up. Both arms are raised symmetrically overhead, palms together as if catching falling water. A single bright meteor's trail appears to plunge into the figure's cupped hands. The figure wears a long undyed linen robe that pools on the sand in a pale mound. Long hair falls down the back in a single unbraided river. Around the figure, sand is rippled in delicate wind patterns. Far in the background, a ridge of darker dunes cuts a gentle S-curve against the horizon. Above, the sky is a dense river of stars; perhaps a dozen meteor trails are visible at varying lengths, the longest ones curving gently with atmospheric perspective. Lighting is moonless starlight; the figure is lit only by the night sky and by a faint warm glow that seems to be coming from the cupped hands themselves, as if the meteor has actually arrived. Mood: liturgical desert silence. EFFECTS: long exposure, glow.

prompts.title: Diner Tailgate at Dusk
prompts.description: On the tailgate of a beat-up pickup outside a diner, legs swinging
prompts.descriptionRu: На откидном борту пикапа у придорожной закусочной, ноги болтаются
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure sits on the open tailgate of a beat-up pickup truck parked at a midwestern roadside diner at dusk. Medium shot from a low angle. The figure swings both legs over the tailgate's edge, ankles crossed, kicking gently at the air. The right hand cups a chocolate milkshake topped with a maraschino cherry; the straw is in the figure's mouth mid-sip. The left hand holds a folded greasy paper bag of fries on the lap, one fry pinched between thumb and forefinger of the right hand even as that hand also holds the milkshake (improbable but committed). The figure's eyes are crinkled in pleasure, head tilted slightly, gazing somewhere into the middle distance. The figure wears a denim jacket over a faded band t-shirt, cuffed jeans, scuffed cowboy boots. Inside the truck bed behind: a rolled-up sleeping bag, a battered acoustic guitar without a case, a road atlas open and fluttering, a tangle of camping rope. Behind the truck, the diner's vintage neon "OPEN" sign and a slice of empty highway disappearing into a flat horizon under a sherbet sunset. Lighting is warm magenta-orange from the sky plus a buzzing red wash from the diner sign. Mood: contented vagrancy.

prompts.title: Lone House in Snow Field
prompts.description: Tiny on the doorstep of a single house in an endless snow field
prompts.descriptionRu: Крошечная фигурка у порога одинокого дома в бескрайнем снегу
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration of a figure standing on the doorstep of a tiny isolated house in a vast snowy field, captured from medium-far. The whole frame is dominated by white snow and white sky, the small dark house and figure in the center. The door of the house is open behind the figure, spilling warm yellow light onto the snowy step. The figure stands frozen mid-step, half-out, half-in, with one boot still on the threshold and one in the snow. The right hand grips a heavy coat that's only on one shoulder, the other arm not yet through the sleeve. The left hand is raised flat in a "wait" gesture, palm out, toward something off-frame to the left. The face is turned to the same direction, mouth open in a small surprised "oh", eyes fixed on what we cannot see. Around the house, virgin snow stretches to a flat horizon, a single line of fence-posts marching off to the right corner. A single wisp of chimney smoke. Lighting is the warm interior glow against the cold blue ambient of arctic afternoon. Mood: an interrupted decision.

prompts.title: Diner Booth, Jukebox Glow
prompts.description: Slumped low in a red vinyl booth, lit only by a glowing jukebox
prompts.descriptionRu: Сполз вниз в красном виниловом диванчике, освещён только музыкальным автоматом
prompts.body: SCENE: A close-up of a figure inside a vintage diner booth at midnight, lit only by an enormous jukebox. The figure has slid down low in the red vinyl booth so the chin almost touches the formica table. Only the upper half of the face is above the table edge - eyes half-lidded, eyebrows up in a slow sleepy seriousness. The right hand is raised above the table, holding a single french fry pointed at the camera like a fencing épée. The left hand is hidden under the table. On the table: a half-eaten cheeseburger, a malted milkshake with a long-straw poking up, a small ceramic ashtray, a folded handwritten note. The booth's red vinyl is cracked along the top piping. The jukebox dominates the right side of the frame, glowing in pulses of pink, gold, and teal. Lighting is jukebox-driven, color-cycling, with rainbow gels chasing across the figure's face frame by frame. The chrome of the table and the napkin dispenser catches the colors. Mood: delirious 2 a.m. seriousness. EFFECTS: scan lines overlay, chromatic aberration.

prompts.title: Dawn Surf, Rolled Jeans
prompts.description: Ankle-deep in gray surf at dawn, toes burrowed in wet sand
prompts.descriptionRu: По щиколотку в сером прибое на рассвете, пальцы зарыты в мокрый песок
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands ankle-deep in the surf of a gray ocean at dawn, captured in profile from the thigh up. The figure has rolled jeans up to mid-shin, the toes are buried. Both hands are tucked deep into the front pockets of an oversized fisherman's sweater. The shoulders are slightly hunched against the cold. The head is lowered, gaze fixed on the foam swirling around the ankles, hair lifting in the offshore breeze. A small flock of dunlins is suspended mid-flight just past the figure's shoulder, tracing a low V. The horizon is a soft pearl-gray meeting a deeper slate sea, no sun visible - only its diffuse rumor lighting the underbelly of the cloud bank in cold rose.
