Wet sand stretches behind the figure with a single line of footprints leading from the upper-right corner. A piece of green sea-glass winks from beside the right foot. Mood: pre-coffee ocean truce.

prompts.title: Night Bus Window
prompts.description: Slumped sideways on a long bench, forehead against the window
prompts.descriptionRu: Развалился боком на длинном сиденье, лоб прижат к окну
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure rides a city bus at night, captured from across the aisle. The figure sits sideways on a long bench seat, body slumped against the rear-side window, head tilted, one cheek squashed against the cold glass. Eyes are wide open, glassy with exhaustion, staring at the camera with no recognition - a person who has gone through the wall. The right arm hugs a backpack pulled into the lap; the left hand is wedged between the thigh and the seat, holding a melting ice-cream cone partially upside down. A drip has reached the wrist. The figure wears a thin parka, one earbud dangling out and the other still in. Behind the figure, the dark city slides past the window in neon streaks - pink, green, white - blurred long-exposure shapes. The bus interior is jaundiced fluorescent yellow with hard shadows under the seats. A single other passenger is slumped at the back of the frame, only their hat visible. Lighting is hard greenish-yellow overhead and pink-blue motion-streaks from outside, mixing on the figure's face. Mood: late-shift commuter dissociation.

prompts.title: Eye of the Mess
prompts.description: Calm centre of a tornado-struck bedroom, everything else in chaos
prompts.descriptionRu: Спокойный центр разрушенной спальни, всё остальное в хаосе
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is captured from the front, sitting calmly at the eye of an absolutely chaotic bedroom that looks tornado-struck, in a wide interior shot. The figure sits cross-legged in the exact center of a bare patch of carpet, hands folded primly in lap, posture upright, expression saintly serene with eyes gently closed and a small smile. The chaos radiates outward in a perfect debris circle: an explosion of clothing, scattered papers, knocked-over books, a collapsed shoe rack, a houseplant on its side spilling soil, a fallen lamp still lit and pointing wrong, a single sock improbably stuck to the ceiling, an open suitcase upended. A laptop balanced on a teetering pile flickers with a paused cartoon. The figure wears clean folded-looking pajamas, hair brushed. Lighting is the warm cozy glow of the still-on lamp from the floor mixed with cold blue from the laptop screen. Mood: meditative defeat. NEGATIVE: tidy room (the chaos must be visibly extreme).

prompts.title: Bridge Railing at Dusk
prompts.description: Perched sideways on iron rail, city skyline behind
prompts.descriptionRu: Сидит боком на железных перилах, силуэт города позади
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration of a figure perched on the iron railing of a bridge at dusk. Medium-wide shot, the figure to the left third of the frame. The figure sits sideways on the railing, both legs swung over to the river side of the bridge, with the left arm wrapped around a vertical iron support and the right hand cupped around the mouth as if calling out across the water. The face is in three-quarter view to the camera, mouth open in mid-shout, eyes squinted in the effort. The figure wears a long, billowing rain jacket the color of egg yolk, and rubber boots. Below the bridge, the river is a wide dark pewter ribbon with a single skinny sculler far downstream, and a flock of geese in a low V cutting the water. Across the river, a bank of half-built brutalist apartment blocks under cranes, lit by sodium worklights. The bridge itself is rust-streaked iron lattice. Lighting is overcast dusk with a single distant orange crane light. Mood: shouted secret to a city that doesn't care.

prompts.title: Radio Booth, Headphones
prompts.description: On a stool with oversized cans, hands cupping the mic in confession
prompts.descriptionRu: На стуле в больших наушниках, ладони обнимают микрофон в исповеди
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration captured at eye-level inside a small recording booth in a radio station. The figure sits on a stool wearing oversized headphones, both hands wrapped tight around the metal lollipop microphone in front. The figure is leaned forward into the mic with mouth open mid-word, eyes locked closed, expression utterly absorbed. A faint blush. The figure wears a cozy oatmeal-colored cardigan, the sleeves pulled down over the hands. On the music stand: a stack of yellow scripts, the top page underlined heavily in red marker, a steaming mug of tea. The booth walls are foam-cone soundproofing in alternating teal and gray hexagonal panels. Through a small interior window behind the figure, a producer in headphones is visible giving a thumbs-up. The "ON AIR" sign glows red above the door, casting a faint warm wash. Lighting is a single overhead LED key plus the red ON-AIR ambient, splitting the figure into two-tone. Mood: confiding to ten thousand strangers at once.

prompts.title: Zero-G Fetal Float
prompts.description: Curled in a small spacecraft, hair fanned out around the head
prompts.descriptionRu: Свернулся в маленьком корабле, волосы веером вокруг головы
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure floats in zero-gravity in the cylindrical interior of a small spacecraft, captured in a square 1:1 frame. The figure is curled into a loose fetal float, body tilted at a 30-degree off-axis angle, hair fanned upward. Both hands cradle a small clear glass globe of water with a single goldfish swimming inside. The figure's eyes are open in calm wonder, gazing at the fish. The figure wears a white jumpsuit with patches on the shoulder, socks, no shoes. Around the figure, the cylindrical cabin: padded walls in pale beige, multiple small portholes around the curve, a clipboard tethered by a curling cord, a half-eaten food pouch drifting near the ceiling, a stylus floating beside it. Out the largest porthole, Earth fills the view as a curve of blue and white cloud, the terminator line cutting across continents. Lighting is two-source: a hard white astronaut spotlight directly above and the soft Earth-glow from the porthole bouncing pale blue along the figure's underside. Mood: gentle interstellar custodianship.

prompts.title: Sprint Across the Field
prompts.description: Mid-stride across dry summer grass, both legs airborne, eyes ahead
prompts.descriptionRu: В шаге через сухую летнюю траву, обе ноги в воздухе, взгляд вперёд
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure runs full-tilt across a flat field of dry summer grass, captured from a side tracking angle, mid-stride. Both legs are airborne, body tilted forward, arms pumping with the right arm forward and the left arm back. The figure clutches a long red ribbon of kite string in the right hand; behind the figure, against a brilliant summer sky, an enormous handmade box-kite - six panels of mismatched fabrics: paisley, gingham, polka-dot, plain - soars far above. The figure's head is thrown back to see the kite, mouth wide open in an unrestrained scream of laughter, hair flying. The figure wears denim shorts, a sleeveless white tank, dirty sneakers. The grass is dotted with white and yellow daisies. The horizon is a long line of dark green forest. The sky is cobalt with three perfect fluffy cumulus clouds spaced like a rhythm section. Lighting is direct overhead summer sun with rich saturated colors. Mood: the perfect fact of running with a kite in any decade. EFFECTS: crayon drawing overlay, motion blur. The crayon overlay is in primary fat-stick colors drawn directly across the sky and grass: a crooked yellow sun in the upper-left with a smiling face, three blue scribble-clouds, the kite outlined in red as if traced over the photograph, and the words "I FLEW" in shaky green capital letters along the bottom edge - drawn by the figure himself the day after, on a printed copy.

prompts.title: Climbing in the Window
prompts.description: Half-through a darkened kitchen window, frozen in mid-trespass
prompts.descriptionRu: Наполовину влез в тёмное кухонное окно, замер на полпути
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration of a figure climbing through the open window of a kitchen at the back of a darkened house - captured from inside the kitchen looking at the window. The figure is straddling the window-frame, halfway in, halfway out: the right leg already on the linoleum kitchen floor, the left leg still on the back porch outside. Both hands grip the upper window frame above the head. The body is twisted to face the camera; the face is caught in a "shhh" expression - index finger of an impossible third hand would be at the lips, but here the figure compromises by biting the lower lip. Eyes are wide and gleaming. The figure wears all black, a beanie pulled low, and is conspicuously carrying a giant cardboard birthday cake box strapped to the back like a backpack. On the kitchen counter behind the camera POV, a sleeping dog is visible on its bed, ears beginning to twitch. Outside the window, a moonlit suburban backyard with a swing set. Lighting is silver-blue moonlight through the window mixed with the dim red glow of a microwave clock from the camera's side. Mood: surprise-party reconnaissance.

prompts.title: Pink Bubblegum Bubble
prompts.description: Inside a car-sized chewing-gum bubble he's still blowing
prompts.descriptionRu: Внутри пузыря жвачки размером с машину, который всё ещё надувает
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure sits inside an enormous translucent bubble of pink chewing gum, captured eye-level. The bubble is the size of a small car and is being inflated by the figure who is in the act of blowing it; it has stretched far past the face and now the head is barely visible inside the gum, the figure's hair and face squashed in pink translucent membrane. The eyes are bulging slightly with comic strain, eyebrows up high. Both hands are pressed against the inside walls of the bubble, fingers spread. The figure wears a 90s tracksuit in baby blue and a backwards baseball cap. The setting is a cracked basketball court at night under a single orange sodium lamp. A skateboard lies abandoned in the foreground. Lighting is one overhead sodium key from above-right that glows through the pink gum, turning the figure into a pink-gold silhouette. Mood: the precise instant before catastrophic pop. NEGATIVE: gum already burst.

prompts.title: 3 A.M. Produce Aisle
prompts.description: Squatting low in fluorescent grocery aisle, lemon in hand
prompts.descriptionRu: Присел в овощном отделе под флуоресцентной лампой, лимон в руке
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure crouches in the produce aisle of a fluorescent-lit late-night grocery store, captured from a low angle along the floor. The figure is in a deep squat, knees together, arms resting on knees, both hands cupping a single large overripe peach as if it were a small holy object. The face is bent low to it, eyes closed, the figure has clearly just sniffed and is in a state of mid-revelation. The figure wears a long camel coat over flannel pajamas, sheepskin slippers, hair half-tied. Around the squat: glossy mountains of stacked produce - apples, pears, mangoes - in tiered displays under a misting jet that has just released a curtain of water-fog over the greens behind. A spinning rack of plastic produce bags, a forgotten basket on the floor with a baguette, a single rolling avocado. Lighting is unforgiving overhead fluorescent flat with the mister catching the cold light in tiny droplets. Mood: 11 p.m. agricultural epiphany.

prompts.title: Backwards Dive into Laundry
prompts.description: Horizontal mid-fall above a pile of unfolded laundry
prompts.descriptionRu: Горизонтальный полёт спиной над кучей нескладного белья
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands in the middle of a bedroom doing a perfect backwards dive onto a pile of unfolded laundry. Captured mid-flight, the figure horizontal in the air about to land, body fully arched in a perfect swan-dive backbend. Both arms are out in a T, eyes closed, mouth in a beatific pre-impact smile. The figure wears mismatched pajamas: striped pants, a polka-dot top. Hair flying. The pile of laundry below is an impossible mound of clean folded items already going to be re-rumpled - towels, t-shirts, fitted sheets, a single sock fluttering off the top in disturbed air. A woven laundry basket lies tipped on its side. The bedroom around: an unmade bed, a wall of pinned photos, an open closet, a guitar leaned in the corner, a string of fairy lights along one wall. Lighting is warm afternoon golden hour from the window, igniting the laundry pile in honeyed light. Mood: domestic-physics rebellion.

prompts.title: Peeking from a Box
prompts.description: Half-visible above the rim of a giant cardboard moving box
prompts.descriptionRu: Виден наполовину над краем огромной картонной коробки
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is captured peeking out from inside a very large cardboard moving box in the middle of an empty living room. Only the top half of the figure is visible above the box's open flaps. Both hands grip the box rim. The figure has placed an old colander on the head as a knight's helmet. The face is composed in a heroic forward gaze with a single eyebrow raised, mouth set in stoic determination, a streak of marker on the cheek as warpaint. A wooden spoon is gripped in the right hand and held upright like a sword. The box is labeled in marker: "FRAGILE - WAR MACHINE". The room around the box is otherwise nearly empty: bare walls with picture-hook holes, two cardboard boxes stacked at the side, a single house plant, a sleeping dog with one eyebrow raised at the figure. Lighting is bright white midday from a curtainless window, casting hard shadows. Mood: the chivalry of moving day.

prompts.title: Coffee Cup, Cupped Hands
prompts.description: Tight close-up, steaming cup raised under the chin, soft warmth
prompts.descriptionRu: Тесный крупный план, дымящаяся кружка под подбородком, мягкое тепло
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure is captured indoors in a very tightly cropped close-up, holding a single steaming cup of coffee in cupped hands directly under the chin. The cup is in the immediate foreground. Steam rises and curls in soft tendrils around the figure's chin and lower face. The figure's eyes are visible above the steam, half-closed in pre-caffeine zombification, dark circles beneath. The mouth behind the steam is set in a flat tired line. Hair is wild bedhead. The figure wears a thick oatmeal-cable-knit sweater, the cuffs falling around the hands. Behind the figure, soft out-of-focus blur: a sunny window, a paperback book face-down, a houseplant. Lighting is morning-window soft, with the steam catching the directional light in feathered rays. Mood: the small minute before a person becomes a person again.

prompts.title: Rural Platform, One Lamp
prompts.description: Tiny under a single lamp-post on a country platform at night
prompts.descriptionRu: Крошечная фигурка под одним фонарём на сельской платформе ночью
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure stands on a rural train platform at night, captured from across the tracks looking at the figure under a single lamp-post. The figure is small and centered, holding a small leather suitcase in the right hand at the side, the left hand raised in a flat, simple wave to no one - just the empty rails. The face is a small smile, neither happy nor sad, eyes lifted. The figure wears a wool greatcoat that nearly reaches the ground, a knit hat. The platform is pale concrete, a single wooden bench off to the right, a metal sign reading "PLATFORM 2". Beyond the platform, the small ticket-house is dark. Past the rails, fields of black grass, a far line of pines, an enormous low full moon rising. The lamp's halo above the figure is the only warm thing in the scene. Lighting is one tungsten lamp casting a perfect cone of warm yellow on the figure with cool deep-blue ambient everywhere else. Mood: arrival and departure indistinguishable.

prompts.title: Hostel Bathtub Squat
prompts.description: Folded into a tiny hostel tub, looking up through the curtain
prompts.descriptionRu: Сложился в крошечной ванне хостела, смотрит вверх сквозь штору
prompts.body: SCENE: A figure squats inside an empty bathtub in a small low-ceilinged hostel bathroom, captured at a downward angle through the open shower curtain. The bathtub is a pale yellow porcelain. The figure has not run any water; instead, the tub is covered in a layer of crumpled travel-receipts, train tickets, foreign banknotes, and dog-eared postcards. The figure is in the act of reading one - a postcard held in both hands at face-height, brow furrowed, eyes scanning. A small smile is forming at the corner of the mouth. The figure wears traveler's clothes - a faded band t-shirt, loose linen pants - and is barefoot. A backpack lies open on the bathroom floor outside the tub, more papers spilling out. The bathroom is tiled in cracked beige hexagons, a buzzing fluorescent strip light overhead, a tiny window with frosted glass admitting blue evening. Lighting is harsh fluorescent overhead, color-temperature mismatched with the warm window blue. Mood: archaeology of a long trip.

sections.name: Couple
sections.description: 20 two-figure scenes about intimacy, friction, and quiet closeness
sections.descriptionRu: 20 парных сцен об интимности, трении и тихой близости

prompts.title: Candlelit Attic Armchair
prompts.description: Two figures sharing one chair, a grape mid-air between them
prompts.descriptionRu: Двое в одном кресле, виноградина в воздухе между ними
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration in 16:9 aspect. Two figures share a single oversized armchair in a candlelit attic. The first figure (right) is sprawled sideways across the chair with the legs draped over one armrest; the head rests in the lap of the second figure (left), who sits properly upright. The second figure looks down at the first figure with an expression of patient indulgence; the first figure looks straight up at the second figure with a wide goofy grin, mouth open mid-joke. The second figure's right hand is in the act of feeding a single grape into the first figure's open mouth - the grape suspended midair between thumb and forefinger. The second figure's left hand absently strokes the first figure's hair. The first figure's left hand drapes off the side of the chair holding a paperback novel face-down; the right hand is raised, fingers curled around the wrist of the second figure as if holding a pulse. The first figure wears striped pajamas; the second figure wears a long velvet robe over a slip. Around them, an attic with sloped wooden beams, a stained-glass round window, towers of stacked books, three lit candles in mismatched holders, a sleeping ginger cat at their feet. Lighting is warm orange candlelight from below-screen-left and cooler moonlight from the round window. Mood: long-broken-in love. EFFECTS: pen doodles overlay, soft focus. The doodles are blue ballpoint, scrawled across the attic walls behind the figures: a small heart with both their initials inside (just "M+" and "+J", placeholders), a crooked arrow pointing at the candle that says "still on FIRE 8 yrs", a small star above the cat. The doodles are clearly the work of one of them on a long boring afternoon.

prompts.title: Running in the Rain
prompts.description: Both airborne mid-stride on a wet boardwalk, umbrella inverted
prompts.descriptionRu: Оба в полёте на мокром настиле, зонт вывернут наизнанку
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration of two figures running together along a wet boardwalk in the rain, captured in a side tracking shot, both fully airborne mid-stride. The first figure (left) is taller and is leaning forward, the right arm thrown up overhead holding a small umbrella that is doing nothing useful in the wind, the umbrella inverted. The first figure's left hand is locked in an iron grip with the second figure's right hand. The second figure (right) is laughing so hard the eyes are squeezed shut, head thrown back, free left hand flung wide for balance, hair plastered to the face. Both are completely soaked. The first figure wears a long oversized blazer turned dark with rain over jeans; the second figure wears a yellow summer dress now translucent and clinging, sneakers. Spray kicks up at every footfall. Around: a wet wooden boardwalk slick with sheen, a row of arcade façades on the right (cracked neon "RIDES", a faded carousel just visible, a closed cotton candy stand), the dark gray ocean to the left with white-cap waves, a sky of sheeting rain. A single seagull is hunkered on a railing, judging. Lighting is overcast diffuse with the warm pinks of the arcade neon kicking in along the right. Mood: weather as accomplice.

prompts.title: Threaded Fingers, Silver
prompts.description: Extreme close-up of laced hands with a silver thread between fingers
prompts.descriptionRu: Крупный план сплетённых рук, серебряная нить между пальцами
prompts.body: SCENE: An extreme close-up of two figures' clasped hands in the immediate foreground, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame. The first figure's hand is on top, fingers laced through the second figure's. A simple silver thread is knotted around the joined index fingers. The skin tones differ; the first figure's hand has chipped black nail polish and three small henna marks on the back, the second figure's hand has a faint scar across the knuckles. Out of focus behind the hands, far in the background, both figures are barely visible: one in a deep red sweater, one in a pale blue shirt, both seated at a small café table outdoors, faces turned away from the camera, both looking at the same far-off thing. The table holds two espresso cups, one almost full and one almost empty. The café is on a cobblestoned European side-street. The depth of field is razor-thin: only the threaded fingers are sharp. Lighting is warm late-afternoon side-light catching on the fine silver thread, making it glow. Mood: a vow agreed to wordlessly. EFFECTS: bokeh, golden hour.

prompts.title: Dorm Bed Top-View
prompts.description: Two heads opposite, feet tangled in the middle of a twin bed
prompts.descriptionRu: Две головы напротив, ноги переплетены посередине
prompts.body: SCENE: An overhead bird's-eye view directly above a small twin bed in a college dorm. Two figures are crammed onto the narrow mattress in opposite directions: the first figure's head is at the top of the bed (facing the foot), the second figure's head is at the foot of the bed (facing the top). Both are on their backs, looking up at the camera/ceiling. Their feet meet in the middle and are casually tangled. The first figure (top of frame) holds an open laptop balanced on the chest; on the laptop screen visible from above, a paused movie. The second figure (bottom of frame) holds a giant bag of popcorn between both hands at chest level. Both faces are tilted slightly, mouths open in mid-laugh, eyes locked on each other across the upside-down geometry. A pile of pillows is shoved against the wall on one side. Strewn on the bed and floor: open textbooks, fairy lights tangled, an empty pizza box, a single fuzzy slipper. The bedspread is tie-dyed. Lighting is the cool blue glow of the laptop combined with one warm desk lamp tilted strangely off the desk. Mood: the casual closeness of long platonic intimacy. EFFECTS: sticker collage overlay, cool tones.

prompts.title: Library Aisle Meet-Cute
prompts.description: Reaching for the same green book on a bottom shelf, hands almost meeting
prompts.descriptionRu: Тянутся за одной зелёной книгой, ладони почти встречаются
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration of two figures meeting unexpectedly in a narrow library aisle. Captured from a low angle along the floor between two tall shelves of books vanishing into one-point perspective. Both figures are crouched at exactly the same low shelf, reaching for the same book, their fingers about to meet on the same dark green spine. Both have frozen in the small instant of mutual recognition. The first figure (left) has long hair half-falling forward, eyes wide; the second figure (right) wears small round glasses, mouth open as if about to apologize. Their other hands grip clutched stacks of books against their chests in mirrored postures. Both are kneeling with one knee on the carpet, one foot flat. A single dust mote floats between them. Around: floor-to-ceiling old wooden shelves, the books worn and various, a brass shelf-label visible reading "POETRY 821-825", a sleeping cat-shaped doorstop. The library beyond the aisle is darker and warmer with green-shaded lamps. Lighting is one shaft of cool window light cutting across the aisle from the left, illuminating the dust between the meeting hands. Mood: the precise photographable instant of meet-cute.

prompts.title: Head-to-Head in Wheat
prompts.description: Side-by-side on backs at twilight, hands meeting above the heads
prompts.descriptionRu: Рядом на спинах в сумерках, руки соединены над головами
prompts.body: SCENE: A wide horizontal illustration of two figures lying flat on their backs side-by-side in a wheat field at twilight. Captured from directly above. They lie head-to-head, tops of heads touching, bodies extending in opposite directions making a single long line. Both are looking straight up at the camera/sky. The first figure (frame-left torso) has one knee bent, foot flat in the wheat; the second figure (frame-right torso) has both legs straight. Their hands meet between the heads in a casual interlace at the top of the frame. The first figure holds a small bundle of wildflowers loosely in the free outer hand; the second figure holds a single Polaroid photograph face-down in the free outer hand. Both wear soft pastels that don't match - first figure in a faded sage shirt, second figure in dusty rose. The wheat is golden-amber under twilight, lying in a flattened depression made by their bodies. The sky is a deep purple-blue with the first three stars visible. Lighting is the dying red-violet of last sunset on the cheeks, an even ambient blue from the sky on the bodies. Mood: parallel solitude that has chosen each other.

prompts.title: Kitchen Slow Waltz
prompts.description: Barefoot ballroom frame on checkered linoleum, foreheads touching
prompts.descriptionRu: Босиком в бальной позе на шахматном линолеуме, лбы соприкасаются
prompts.body: SCENE: A close-up illustration of two figures locked in a slow waltz inside a tiny rural kitchen. Both are barefoot on a black-and-white checkered linoleum floor. The first figure (lead, left) holds the second figure's right hand at shoulder height in a classic ballroom frame; the first figure's right hand rests at the small of the second figure's back. The second figure (follow, right) has the left hand resting at the first figure's shoulder. Their faces are very close, foreheads almost touching, eyes closed, both wearing small private smiles. The first figure wears a wrinkled white button-down shirt, sleeves rolled, brown trousers. The second figure wears a worn-out plain grey t-shirt and pajama shorts. The kitchen is small and lived-in: a pot bubbling on a gas stove behind them with steam rising, a mismatched mug on the counter, a window above the sink full of late-evening pale rose light, a hanging strip of dried herbs, an old portable radio plugged in on the counter playing something only they hear. A wooden spoon rests forgotten on the floor near their feet. Lighting is the warm tungsten over-stove lamp with cool pink window light. Mood: a romance that doesn't need an audience.

prompts.title: Subway Stares Across Aisle
prompts.description: Four feet of empty aisle between two seated figures, mutual gaze
prompts.descriptionRu: Четыре фута пустого прохода между двумя сидящими, обмен взглядами
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration captured from inside a moving subway car at night. Two figures sit across the aisle from each other, each in a separate row of seats, facing each other. The car is otherwise empty. The first figure (left of frame) sits with knees together, hands folded in lap, gazing intently at the second figure with a small uncertain smile. The second figure (right of frame) leans back with one arm slung over the seat-back, head tilted, returning the gaze with a steadier, half-amused expression - one eyebrow raised. There are precisely four feet of empty subway aisle between them. Neither wears outdoor gear that matches; the first figure has a short floral dress and combat boots, the second figure has a charcoal suit with no tie. Above their heads, the subway car's overhead grab-rail and a row of advertisements: a generic fake travel poster ("PARADISE"), a missing-cat poster, a public service announcement. Through the dark windows behind them, light-streaks of the tunnel race horizontally, giving a sense of speed. Lighting is harsh blue-white fluorescent overhead with subtle vibration blur visible only on the seats - they are perfectly sharp. Mood: the lengthy held moment of "should I move closer?".

prompts.title: Balloon Basket Anchor
prompts.description: One leans out shouting, the other grips their coat with affection
prompts.descriptionRu: Один свесился с криком, другой держит его за пальто с нежностью
prompts.body: SCENE: A medium-shot illustration of two figures in a hot-air balloon basket, captured from across the basket as if from another nearby balloon. The first figure (left in basket) leans far over the wicker rim, both forearms on the lip, mouth wide open in a delighted shout downward at the world below, hair streaming back, eyes squinted in the wind. The second figure (right in basket) has one hand calmly on the burner-rope handle keeping the balloon steady, the other hand reaches forward to grip the back of the first figure's coat in a gentle "don't fall" anchor. The second figure smiles at the first figure with fond amusement, head shaking. Both wear thick winter coats - the first in a vintage red wool, the second in a long brown duster. The wicker basket is covered in stickers and a small picnic basket and a thermos. Above them, the giant balloon canopy is a riot of patchwork colors. Below: the green-and-tan patchwork of farmland at dawn, a thin river ribbon, two horses in a field looking up. Lighting is direct golden dawn from screen-right with a strong warm rim around both heads and the edge of the balloon. Mood: one careful, one boundless.

prompts.title: Fire Escape Cigarette
prompts.description: Shoulders touching on iron stairs at twilight, mostly silence
prompts.descriptionRu: Плечи соприкасаются на железных ступенях в сумерках, тишина
prompts.body: SCENE: A close-up of two figures sitting together on a fire escape stair landing at twilight, captured from a slightly low front angle. They are seated on the same metal grating step. The first figure (left) sits hugging knees to chest, chin resting on the knees, looking straight at the camera with a small contented sleepy expression. The second figure (right) sits with legs dangling between the iron bars, leaning back on both palms behind, head tipped back to the sky, eyes closed. Their shoulders touch. A single shared cigarette is held between the second figure's lips; smoke curls upward. The first figure's right hand is holding a half-eaten plum; the second figure's right hand has a small cassette tape balanced on the kneecap. The first figure wears a vintage leather jacket two sizes too big over a band shirt; the second figure wears an oversized white button-down with the sleeves rolled. Behind them, the iron grating recedes; below, a narrow city alley with a single warm window across the way; above, a sky of dusky lavender with the first stars. Lighting is the alley's pink-orange neon spilling from the right with the violet sky as ambient. Mood: a friendship that's mostly silence and that's the point.

prompts.title: Pillow Fort Universe
prompts.description: Chest-to-chest under a fairy-lit fort, noses an inch apart
prompts.descriptionRu: Грудь к груди под крепостью с гирляндами, носы в сантиметре
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration captured from above of two figures lying chest-to-chest, eye-to-eye, on a soft floor of pillows, blankets, and stuffed animals - a tower of bedding clearly built for a private fort. The first figure is on the bottom, face up, both arms loose at the sides; the second figure is on top, propped on both elbows above the first figure, knees on the bedding. The second figure is mid-laugh, looking down at the first figure who returns the gaze with a tender, unguarded expression. Their noses are an inch apart. The first figure wears an oversized hoodie; the second figure wears a worn t-shirt, both with bare legs in cozy socks. Around them, a dome of shared blankets has been propped up by chair-backs and broomsticks creating a soft cave; fairy lights are tangled across the inside roof of the fort. Two open books, a half-eaten chocolate bar, and a thermos sit at the edge of the pillow-pile. Lighting is the warm amber-red of all the fairy lights inside the fort - no other source. Mood: an entire universe shrunk to one dome of fabric. EFFECTS: chalk scribbles overlay, warm tones. The chalk is white, applied to the inside walls of the fort itself: a fast childlike map of an imaginary country labeled "OURS", a list of "RULES" with three numbered bullet points unreadable, a single very large "DO NOT EXIT" near the entrance. The drawings read as defaced by both figures together over many evenings.

prompts.title: Piano Duet, Shared Joke
prompts.description: Four hands in counterpoint, both heads turned for a sideways glance
prompts.descriptionRu: Четыре руки в контрапункте, обе головы повёрнуты для бокового взгляда
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration of two figures playing a piano duet on a single piano bench, captured from behind. Both bodies in identical posture, leaning slightly forward, four hands arranged on the keys in coordinated counterpoint - the first figure's hands on the lower octaves to the left, the second figure's hands on the upper octaves to the right. Their elbows touch. Their heads are turned ninety degrees toward each other in tandem mid-note, both giving a knowing sideways glance with private smiles, sharing a private joke in the music. The first figure wears a long-sleeved black shirt; the second figure wears a cream cardigan. Above the piano: a row of framed sepia photographs and a single cup of tea on a saucer perched on the piano top. The room is a cluttered music room with sheet music on every surface, a violin case open on the floor, a metronome ticking on the side table, a window of softly raining grey afternoon. Lighting is one low-key floor lamp with an amber shade casting warm raking light across both their backs and reflecting on the piano's glossy black surface. Mood: a conversation that uses no words.

prompts.title: Shared Earbuds at Bus Stop
prompts.description: Tethered by a single headphone cable, no touch except the wire
prompts.descriptionRu: Соединены одним проводом наушников, других прикосновений нет
prompts.body: SCENE: A close-up of two figures sharing a single pair of headphones at a bus stop at night, captured frontally. They sit shoulder-to-shoulder on a metal bench. Each wears one earbud, the cord stretched taut between them like a tether. The first figure (left) tilts the head toward the second figure to keep the cable slack, eyes closed, faint smile, mouthing along to the lyrics. The second figure (right) is mid-mouthing the same lyrics, head also tilted toward the first figure, eyes flicking to the first figure with a "this one - listen to this one" expression. Both have phones balanced on knees showing the same paused track. The first figure wears a long puffy coat; the second figure wears a cropped jacket and a scarf. Their gloved hands are jammed deep in their own respective pockets - no touch between bodies, only the cable. Behind them, a glass-walled bus shelter, an empty road, a single bus visibly approaching from far in the deep background, headlights blooming. A bus-stop ad poster shows a placeholder reading "PLACE NAME" in white sans-serif. Lighting is the bluish bus-stop fluorescent with a warm distant headlamp glow approaching. Mood: 11 p.m. shared discovery. EFFECTS: graffiti tags overlay, cool tones. The graffiti is on the bus shelter glass and the wall behind: spray-painted hearts in pink and yellow with messy drips, a tag reading "NOW" overlapping a rival tag, a small stencil of a cassette tape - by strangers, but happening to frame the two figures perfectly.

prompts.title: Rowboat at Dawn
prompts.description: Cross-legged facing each other on a drifting boat, mirror lake
prompts.descriptionRu: Скрестив ноги, друг напротив друга в дрейфующей лодке, зеркальная вода
prompts.body: SCENE: A wide horizontal illustration. Two figures sit cross-legged on the deck of a small wooden rowboat that's adrift in a perfectly still lake at dawn. They are facing each other, knees nearly touching, the boat completely still on water that mirrors the sky. The first figure (left) holds out both open palms toward the second figure; the second figure (right) is in the act of lowering a tiny folded paper boat into the first figure's hands. Their eyes are locked on the paper boat, both faces serious, the small ceremony silent. The first figure wears a long-sleeved striped shirt; the second figure wears a knit fisherman's sweater. Beside them in the rowboat: a thermos, two empty mugs, a basket with a folded blanket. The boat itself is plain weathered wood, two oars laid flat across the seats. The water reflects the figures, the boat, and the dawn sky perfectly - a doubled world. The lake is ringed with dark fir trees in the distance. The sky is a soft gradient from peach at the horizon to pale blue overhead. Lighting is even cool dawn with a warm horizon kicker. Mood: a private offering.

prompts.title: Tangled on a Small Couch
prompts.description: Overhead view of sleeping figures crammed onto a too-small couch
prompts.descriptionRu: Вид сверху на спящих, втиснувшихся в слишком маленький диван
prompts.body: SCENE: An overhead shot of two figures tangled in sleep on a too-small couch in a cluttered living room. The first figure is on the inside (against the couch back), curled into a comma; the second figure is on the outside, draped half on top of the first figure with one leg thrown over and one hand fallen to the floor. Both are asleep, faces relaxed, the second figure's mouth slightly open. The second figure's hand on the floor is loosely holding the corner of an open paperback book that has fallen page-down. A small dog has claimed the very small remaining couch space at the figures' feet, also asleep, paws twitching mid-dream. The couch is brown corduroy, sagging. A blanket is half-on, half-off, mostly bunched at the second figure's hip. The coffee table beside them has two empty wine glasses, a half-eaten bowl of popcorn, and a TV remote. The TV at the foot of the couch is on, casting blue color onto everything; on its screen, a paused frame of generic film static. Lighting is single-source TV-blue, with one small desk lamp far in the corner adding warm fill. Mood: weeknight collapse. EFFECTS: pen doodles overlay, film grain. The doodles are red ballpoint and scattered very lightly across the photo as if a child found the print and added: a tiny crown above each sleeping figure's head, a speech bubble coming from the dog reading "ENOUGH", three little Zs above the standing wineglass.

prompts.title: Bathroom Mirror Morning
prompts.description: Two figures and two reflections, getting ready in synchrony
prompts.descriptionRu: Две фигуры и два отражения, синхронно собираются
prompts.body: SCENE: A medium illustration of two figures in front of a bathroom mirror getting ready in the morning. Captured frontally - we see both their backs and their reflections in the mirror, four faces total. The first figure (left) is bent forward slightly, brushing teeth vigorously, foam at the corner of the mouth, hair held out of the way by the left hand. The second figure (right) is leaning into the mirror to apply mascara with the right hand, mouth dropped open in the universal mascara-face. Their hips bump. The first figure's free right hand reaches behind without looking and rests casually on the second figure's lower back. The second figure's free left hand is pressed flat on the counter for stability. The first figure wears a towel wrapped at the waist; the second figure wears a slip and bare feet. The counter is cluttered: a hairdryer, an open makeup pouch, a tipped lipstick, two coffee mugs, a single droplet of water mid-fall from the faucet. The mirror has streaks of yesterday's wiping. Lighting is warm bulbs around the mirror plus a sliver of cool morning light from a small window to the left. Mood: practiced choreography.

prompts.title: Across the Museum Vitrine
prompts.description: Bent over the same artifact from opposite sides of glass, eye contact
prompts.descriptionRu: Склонились над одним экспонатом с разных сторон стекла, контакт глаз
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration of two figures separated by a museum vitrine. Captured at a downward 3/4 angle. The first figure (left of vitrine) is bent slightly forward, both palms flat on the glass top, gazing down through the glass at an artifact - a small bronze sculpture of clasped hands on a white pedestal inside. The second figure (right of vitrine) stands across the vitrine in a mirrored posture, both palms also flat on the glass. Their palms are perfectly aligned through the glass: first figure's right palm directly under the second figure's left palm, separated only by the glass thickness. Their faces are tilted up to meet each other's eyes through the reflection of the museum lights on the case. Both expressions are open, slightly stunned, lips parted. The first figure wears a museum docent's name-tag clipped to a navy blazer; the second figure is clearly a visitor in a wool coat. Around them, a cathedral-quiet gallery of marble floor and dim spotlights highlighting other vitrines in the soft background. Lighting is each vitrine internally lit with cool LED, while ambient is warm tungsten - the figures' faces are washed cool from the shared object. Mood: the artifact and the encounter mirror each other.

prompts.title: Pillow Fight Impact
prompts.description: Mid-swing pillow strike captured at the moment of impact, feathers
prompts.descriptionRu: Удар подушкой в момент столкновения, перья летят
prompts.body: SCENE: A close-up of two figures fighting playfully with pillows in a bedroom, captured mid-impact. The first figure (left) is mid-swing, both hands gripping a large pillow, the pillow connecting flat against the second figure's face. Feathers explode in a white halo around the impact zone. The first figure's mouth is wide open in a triumphant battle-cry. The second figure (right) is mid-collapse backwards onto the bed, one arm flailing for balance, the other still holding the half-deflated remains of a previous pillow that has already split open. Both are laughing so hard tears are forming at the corners of the eyes. The first figure wears boxer shorts and a tank top; the second figure wears a oversized band t-shirt. The bedroom is half-disaster: feathers everywhere, the mattress askew, the bedside lamp tipped at a precarious angle, a glass of water on the floor about to be knocked. A small dog watches from the doorway in horrified judgment. Lighting is one warm bedroom lamp casting a low wide beam, motion blur on the swing, individual feathers in suspended razor focus. Mood: completely consensual chaos.

prompts.title: Red Light, Tiny Car
prompts.description: Crammed in the front seats at a red light, traffic alone with them
prompts.descriptionRu: Втиснулись на передние сиденья на красном, дорога только их
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration of two figures crammed into the front seats of a tiny old car at a red traffic light at night. The first figure (driver, left) grips the steering wheel with both hands, leaning forward, head turned all the way to the right toward the second figure with raised eyebrows in a "is this really a good idea?" look. The second figure (passenger, right) is mid-bite of a giant fast-food burger held in both hands, cheeks bulging, eyes wide and locked back at the first figure with an exaggerated innocent shrug - the shoulders are visibly raised. Ketchup has dripped down the second figure's chin. The dashboard glows with the light meter and an old radio glowing green showing "FM 102.4". The rear-view mirror reflects a slice of the back seat strewn with fast-food bags, a discarded jacket, a half-deflated balloon. Outside the windshield, the empty intersection is washed in red traffic light. Through the side windows, blurred wet asphalt and a row of closed shops. Lighting is the red of the traffic light from the front and the warm green of the dashboard from below - a deeply unflattering and beautiful mixture. Mood: late-night accomplices.

prompts.title: Revolving Door Reunion
prompts.description: Hands on opposite sides of revolving glass, recognition mid-rotation
prompts.descriptionRu: Ладони с разных сторон вращающейся двери, узнавание на полпути
prompts.body: SCENE: A vertical illustration of two figures on opposite sides of a glass revolving door at the entrance to an office building during a snowstorm. The first figure (left, inside) is in the act of pushing the revolving door forward to leave; the second figure (right, outside, in the snow) is pushing the same door forward to come in. They both freeze in the same instant, recognizing each other through the glass mid-rotation. Their right hands are flat on the glass at exactly the same height. Their faces are inches apart on either side of the glass; both are in shock - first figure's eyes wide, mouth slightly open; second figure's eyebrows up, mouth in a small disbelieving smile. The first figure wears a sharp business suit and a long camel coat; the second figure is bundled in a thick parka with snow flecking the hood, ungloved fingers red from cold, holding a small bouquet of frozen flowers in the left hand. The office lobby behind the first figure is warm marble and brass; the street behind the second figure is whiteout snow with a single yellow taxi just visible. Lighting is the warm interior tungsten of the lobby on the first figure with the cold blue snow ambient on the second figure, the door's glass dividing two color temperatures down the middle. Mood: the unscheduled reunion.

sections.name: Group & Conceptual
sections.description: 20 group compositions and conceptual setups, from band rehearsals to terrariums
sections.descriptionRu: 20 групповых композиций и концептуальных кадров: от репетиций до террариумов

prompts.title: Fountain Rim, Four Friends
prompts.description: Sweltering piazza, four figures in primary colors, splash chaos
prompts.descriptionRu: Душная пьяцца, четверо в основных цветах, водяной хаос
prompts.body: SCENE: A wide horizontal illustration of four figures crammed onto the rim of a public fountain in a European piazza on a sweltering afternoon. The central figure (focal) sits dead-center, leaning forward with both feet in the fountain water, head thrown back in laughter, holding a half-melted gelato cone aloft like a torch. The figure to the left of center is sprawled on the rim sleeping, arm dangling into the water, fingers trailing. The figure to the right of center is bent over, both hands cupping water to splash a fourth figure in the foreground who is mid-flinch, face screwed up, both hands raised defensively, one shoe already in the water. Each wears summer clothes in a different color - primary red, primary yellow, primary blue, and one in white. The fountain itself has a baroque marble centerpiece of dolphins and cherubs. Behind, a piazza of pale ochre buildings, faded green shutters, a few pigeons, and a distant gelato cart. The cobblestones are worn and dark with splash. Lighting is harsh midday sun directly overhead with strong reflected bounce off the fountain water, casting wobbling caustic patterns on the figures' faces. Mood: collective heatwave delirium. NEGATIVE: only three figures (must be exactly four). EFFECTS: lens flare, water droplets on lens.

prompts.title: Rooftop Triangle
prompts.description: Three friends at sunset - stillness, surrender, joy in one frame
prompts.descriptionRu: Трое на крыше на закате - покой, отдача, радость в одном кадре
prompts.body: SCENE: A digital illustration of three figures forming a triangular composition on a rooftop at sunset. Captured medium-wide, slightly low angle. The first figure (foreground center) sits on the ledge, legs dangling over the city, looking back over the shoulder toward the camera with a small smile. The second figure (background left) stands far behind on the roof, arms wide, face up to the sky. The third figure (background right) is caught mid-cartwheel, body inverted, hair fanning down. Each figure is precisely separated by negative space; none of them is interacting, and yet the three poses make a coherent emotional triangle of stillness, surrender, and joy. The first figure wears denim and a faded t-shirt; the second figure wears a long flowing dress; the third figure wears athletic shorts and a sports bra. The roof is concrete with tar-paper patches, an HVAC unit far in the back, a forgotten lawn chair, a string of cafe lights running along the ledge. The skyline beyond is densely packed with mid-rise buildings, water towers, satellite dishes. The sky is a layered sherbet - peach over cyan over deep purple. Lighting is golden hour from screen-left with strong rim on all three figures. Mood: three friends, three different ways to feel alive.

prompts.title: Izakaya Toast, Five Faces
prompts.description: Five figures crammed at one tiny table, mid-laugh from a punchline
prompts.descriptionRu: Пятеро втиснулись за крохотный столик, смех после кульминации
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration of a school of five figures crowded around a single tiny table in a packed Tokyo izakaya. Captured from a slightly high three-quarter angle. The table is centered and obscenely small for five people; the figures lean into it from all sides, elbows colliding, faces close. The central figure is mid-toast, one arm raised holding a small porcelain sake cup; the other four figures lean in with their own cups raised at slightly different heights, none of them quite making eye contact at the same moment because they are all reacting to a joke the central figure just told. Three are laughing open-mouthed; one is wiping the corner of an eye; one is choking with a fist to the mouth. Each figure wears a slightly different smart-casual outfit - varying jackets, ties loosened. The table is covered in small dishes: yakitori skewers, a half-eaten plate of edamame, a bottle of sake, a bowl of pickled ginger, a steaming bowl of ramen. Behind the figures: a wall plastered in bilingual menus, glowing red lanterns, the chef's hat just visible behind the bar at the edge of the frame. Lighting is warm overhead red-lantern key with cool kicker from a sign through the doorway. Mood: a friendship so old no one remembers the joke's setup. NEGATIVE: empty cups.

prompts.title: Seven Across a Mirror Lake
prompts.description: Sunset, ankle-deep water, seven figures running with their reflections
prompts.descriptionRu: Закат, вода по щиколотку, семеро бегут со своими отражениями
prompts.body: SCENE: A wide horizontal illustration of seven figures running across a long shallow lake at sunset, captured in a side tracking shot. The lake's water is only ankle-deep, mirror-flat, and seems to extend to infinity. The figures are arrayed in a ragged horizontal line across the frame, each frozen at a different point of stride; the second from the left is fully airborne, the figure on the far right has fallen into the water and is laughing on hands and knees, water spraying. The middle figure (focal) is in profile mid-leap, the highest of all. The lake reflects the entire row of figures perfectly, doubling the composition. The horizon is a thin band of dark mountains far in the back; the sky is brilliant orange-red with long cirrus streaks. Each figure wears different summer clothes; one wears a paper crown; one carries a beach umbrella; one is barefoot; the rest wear cheap plastic flip-flops. Spray and ripples carry between them across the otherwise glass-smooth water. Lighting is direct backlit sun from the horizon, silhouetting the figures' edges in incandescent fire while the lake glows beneath. Mood: collective inarticulate joy at the end of a perfect day.

prompts.title: Six Hands, One Bowl
prompts.description: Overhead radial composition of hands reaching for cherries
prompts.descriptionRu: Радиальная композиция сверху: руки тянутся к вишне
prompts.body: SCENE: A close-up overhead shot of six pairs of hands meeting in the center of a round wooden table, all reaching toward the same bowl of cherries in a deliberate Hokusai-like radial composition. Each pair of hands belongs to a different person; the rest of the figures are out of frame. Each pair is at a different angle around the bowl, fingers extended, some already pinching a cherry by the stem, others mid-reach. One hand has nail polish chipped, one has a wedding band, one has henna patterns, one is small and child-sized, one has a leather bracelet, one has paint stains. The bowl is white ceramic, full of glossy red cherries with green stems, perched on a striped tablecloth. Around the bowl: an open jar of jam with a sticky knife, a teapot, two open books, a fountain pen, a single dropped cherry rolling away. Lighting is warm window-side morning light from screen-left, casting six soft hand-shadows that converge on the bowl. Mood: the small ritual of Sunday morning communal hunger.

prompts.title: Mall Corridor in Five Frames
prompts.titleRu: Коридор торгового центра в пяти кадрах
prompts.description: One figure walking past the camera across five stitched panels
prompts.descriptionRu: Один человек идёт мимо камеры через пять склеенных кадров
prompts.body: SCENE: A 16:9 conceptual illustration of a single figure walking through a deserted shopping mall at night, captured in five repeated frames stitched together horizontally as if from one long security camera, with the figure visible in each panel at a different stage of the walk. The first panel (far left): figure tiny in the deep distance, just entering the corridor. The second panel: figure halfway closer, the shoulders slumped. The third panel (center, largest figure): figure walking past the camera plane, body mid-stride, face turned to glance directly at the viewer with a flat tired expression. The fourth panel: figure walking away from the camera, getting smaller. The fifth panel: figure tiny again at the far end, just before disappearing. The mall is empty, fluorescent lights buzzing, two-story atrium with shuttered store-fronts, a dead fountain, a single forgotten balloon drifting on the upper level. Lighting is institutional cold white with the same ambient in every panel. The figure wears a long coat and carries a single shopping bag from a now-closed store. Mood: time as a corridor. The five panels are subtly separated by faint vertical timestamp lines. AVOID: writing visible text other than the timestamps.

prompts.title: Twelve in a Bookshop
prompts.description: High-angle on a lunchtime bookstore, twelve micro-scenes coexisting
prompts.descriptionRu: Вид сверху на обеденный книжный, двенадцать микро-сцен сосуществуют
prompts.body: SCENE: A high-angle illustration of a busy independent bookstore at lunchtime with twelve figures occupying different microscenes. Captured from a corner near the ceiling. Foreground: a customer kneeling in front of the lowest shelf of "TRAVEL", squinting at a spine. Mid-distance left: two friends leaning shoulder-to-shoulder in front of "POETRY", one reading a passage aloud. Mid-distance right: a parent and child sharing the floor of the children's nook, a picture book open between them. The center: a long oak table with five mismatched figures all reading silently in unmatched postures - one cross-legged on the table itself, one head-down in hands, one balancing a coffee on a knee. Behind the counter: the bookseller with a stamp poised over a paperback, mid-conversation with a final customer holding three books. Each figure has a clearly individual posture; no two are identical. The bookstore is a dense forest of shelves, hanging Edison bulbs, an overstuffed reading chair, a black cat sleeping on an unsold encyclopedia, a "POEM OF THE DAY" chalkboard reading "YOUR POEM" in placeholder. Lighting is warm tungsten layered in pools across the room with cool window light at the far end. Mood: the collective hush of separate inner worlds.

prompts.title: MOTION Poster
prompts.description: Ten clones of one jump across a gradient, editorial poster layout
prompts.descriptionRu: Десять клонов одного прыжка по градиенту, эдиториальный постер
prompts.body: SCENE: A conceptual high-contrast poster illustration. Centered against a flat cyan background is a figure mid-jump, frozen in the air; cloned ten times in a horizontal row, each clone offset slightly, each in a slightly different stage of the jump - from crouched preparation on the far left to fully airborne in the center to mid-landing on the far right. The colors of the clones cycle through a smooth gradient from deep magenta on the left to pure white in the center to deep cyan on the right. Each clone is fully outlined with a thick clean black line. The figure wears the same outfit in every clone: a slim tracksuit, sneakers, hair tied back. Above the row, in bold white sans-serif text: "MOTION." Below the row, in smaller white text: "every frame is a person." At the bottom corners, two small graphic elements: a circle with a cross and a single asterisk. Lighting in this kind of poster is flat, no source, just the implication of motion through color logic. Mood: the kineticism of self-replication. AVOID: writing text not specified. EFFECTS: glitch distortion overlay, scan lines overlay.

prompts.title: Basement Band Rehearsal
prompts.description: Four-quadrant frame: drummer, guitarist, bassist, singer, locked in
prompts.descriptionRu: Кадр в четырёх квадрантах: барабанщик, гитарист, басист, вокалист
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration of a band rehearsal in a cluttered basement, captured wide. Four figures, each occupying a quadrant of the frame. Top-left: a drummer mid-fill, both sticks airborne, hair flying, sweat on the brow, face contorted in joyful concentration. Top-right: a guitarist with one foot on a small amp, leaning back into a power-chord, head down so the hair curtains the face. Bottom-left: a bassist standing perfectly still with closed eyes, headphones on over the instrument, body the calm center. Bottom-right: a singer, mouth wide at the SM58 mic, free hand clenched at the chest, eyes locked at the camera. The basement is wood-paneled, low-ceilinged, festooned with mismatched gear: a half-eaten pizza box on an amp, a string of Christmas lights, a single saggy couch in the back covered in jackets, a lyric notebook open on the floor. Cables snake across the concrete floor. Lighting is two cheap colored party lights - magenta from the upper-left, cyan from the lower-right - plus one bare bulb on a string. Mood: the intoxication of a band finally locking in.

prompts.title: Empty Seats for Thirteen
prompts.description: Top-down on a round table set for thirteen, only one figure seated
prompts.descriptionRu: Сверху на круглый стол на тринадцать, сидит только один
prompts.body: SCENE: A bird's-eye conceptual top-down illustration of an enormous round formal dining table set for thirteen, but with only one figure seated. The figure is at the very head of the table, captured directly from above, hands folded politely in lap, head tipped slightly back to look up at the camera/ceiling with a small unreadable smile. Twelve other place settings are perfectly arranged around the rest of the table: each with white plate, polished cutlery, folded burgundy napkin, crystal glass - all pristinely empty. The table cloth is bone-white linen. A long candelabra runs the length of the table with seven lit candles. A central platter holds a whole roast pheasant. Beside each empty plate: a small place card folded in half. Each card visibly reads "YOUR NAME" in elegant script (English placeholder). The dining room around the table is glimpsed at the corners: dark parquet floor, the bottom of a chandelier, the suggestion of a long curtain. Lighting is candle-warm from the table center casting twelve doubled shadows of forks across the cloth. Mood: anticipation that may have already passed. AVOID: filling any other seat.

prompts.title: Apartment Block, Lit Windows
prompts.description: Six stories of dioramas, every window a separate tiny life
prompts.descriptionRu: Шесть этажей диорам, в каждом окне своя крошечная жизнь
prompts.body: SCENE: A long horizontal illustration of an entire city block from a low side-on perspective at twilight. The block is a single tall apartment building, six stories of windows, each window a tiny lit diorama showing a different micro-scene. First-floor windows show a laundromat full of figures, a small late-night corner shop with a clerk reading, a tiny restaurant with two diners sharing a plate. Second floor: a child practicing piano in one window; an arguing couple in silhouette in the next. Third floor: a figure dancing alone with headphones; an old figure asleep in a chair under a tilted reading lamp. Fourth floor: a figure painting at an easel; a figure on the toilet; a figure mid-yoga pose. Fifth floor: a figure with a telescope pointed out the window; a figure cooking with billowing steam; an empty window with only a cat. Sixth floor: a single figure on the roof above the building, sitting on the edge, dangling legs. The street below is empty save one cyclist. The sky is a cobalt twilight gradient with a thin moon. Lighting: every window is its own tiny key-light, warm amber, while the building's brick is washed in cold blue ambient. Mood: the city as a Joseph Cornell diorama box.

prompts.title: Chair with a Red String
prompts.description: One chair in a vast white room, a red string running out of frame
prompts.descriptionRu: Один стул в огромной белой комнате, красная нить уходит за кадр
prompts.body: SCENE: A square 1:1 conceptual illustration of a single chair in a vast empty white room, captured frontally. The chair is positioned dead-center, an old wooden Thonet bentwood chair. On the chair's seat sits a precisely folded white t-shirt, a single closed paperback book, a wristwatch face-up, and a small key. A long red string is tied to the back of the chair and extends in a perfectly straight line out of the right edge of the frame. The room is otherwise utterly empty - no walls visible, only an infinite white floor and an infinite white ceiling implied by the absence of horizon. There are no figures. A single shaft of cool light comes from above, casting a hard short shadow under the chair. Mood: an inventory of someone who walked out of frame on purpose. The string is the only saturated color. AVOID: any other object, person, or texture in the empty space.

prompts.title: Three Selves, One Room
prompts.description: Three identical figures sharing one bedroom, none seeing the others
prompts.descriptionRu: Три одинаковые фигуры в одной спальне, не замечают друг друга
prompts.body: SCENE: A wide conceptual illustration of three identical figures (same face, same body, same outfit) inhabiting one bedroom at the same time. Captured from a corner three-quarter angle. The first instance of the figure is asleep in the unmade bed on the left, curled toward the wall. The second instance of the figure is seated at the desk on the right, fully dressed, working on a laptop with a coffee cup, posture sharp. The third instance of the figure stands in the open doorway in the back, dressed in workout clothes, mid-laugh, holding a yoga mat under one arm - about to leave. Each version of the figure is unaware of the others. The room is small, organized in three subtle "zones" matching each instance: the sleep zone on the left, the productivity zone in the middle, the activity zone near the door. Lighting is split into three subtle color washes: cool blue over the bed, neutral white over the desk, warm yellow at the door. Mood: the conflicting selves of one ordinary morning. NEGATIVE: figures noticing each other.

prompts.title: Fifty Faces, One Play
prompts.description: Theater audience from stage view, each face in a different reaction
prompts.descriptionRu: Зал из театра со сцены, у каждого лица своя реакция
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration of an audience of fifty figures in a small black-box theater watching a performance, captured from the stage looking outward. The first three rows are sharp and detailed; the back rows blur into a sea of attentive silhouettes. Each figure in the front rows is rendered in a distinct posture - one figure leaning forward with chin in palm, one figure with arms crossed and head tilted, one figure clutching a partner's hand in their lap, one figure with eyes closed openly weeping, one figure with an expression of irritated boredom, one figure dozing with chin to chest, one figure with a small notebook taking notes. The theater walls are matte black. A single exit-light glows red in the back-left. The seats are red velvet. A faint haze drifts over the audience from a stage smoke machine. The audience is collectively lit only by the spill of stage light from the camera's position, which means each face has the same warm key from below - flattering, golden, theatrical. Mood: fifty different relationships with the same play. NEGATIVE: blank identical faces.

prompts.title: Spiral Staircase Upward
prompts.description: Looking straight up a library spiral, eight figures at different floors
prompts.descriptionRu: Взгляд вверх по библиотечной спирали, восемь фигур на разных этажах
prompts.body: SCENE: A vertical 9:16 illustration of an enormous spiral staircase in an old library tower, captured looking straight up from the bottom. Eight figures are visible at different floors of the spiral, each leaning over a different railing, each a different size due to perspective. The figure at the bottom of the spiral (closest, largest in frame) leans heavily over the railing in the immediate foreground, looking straight up with mouth open in awe, hair falling away. Each subsequent figure higher up the spiral is smaller, and their poses cycle through six different reactions to whatever is at the top: looking up, looking down, leaning, pointing, reading a book, turning to leave. The very top of the spiral, far above, is a tiny circle of bright light against which the highest figure is a black silhouette. The staircase is wrought iron in a deep green, the walls lined with infinite books, each landing a small reading nook. Brass lamps hang on long cords along the inner wall of the spiral, each lamp at a different height. Lighting is warm tungsten lamp-by-lamp with the bright white skylight at the very top crowning the composition. Mood: the architecture of awe.

prompts.title: Before / After Spread
prompts.description: One figure split down the middle: color half vs grayscale half
prompts.descriptionRu: Одна фигура расколота по центру: цветная половина против серой
prompts.body: SCENE: A conceptual editorial illustration designed as a magazine spread. The frame is rectangular, divided down the middle. The left half is full color; the right half is monochrome black-and-white. A single figure stands centered, straddling the divide: the left half of the body in full saturated color (a teal blazer, peachy skin, brown hair, blue jeans), the right half of the body in pure grayscale (the same blazer monochrome, the skin in greys, the jeans dark). The figure faces forward, body squared to the camera, both hands held out at hip level palms-up - the left palm holds a small blooming flower in color; the right palm holds the same flower wilted in monochrome. The face is composed, looking directly at the camera, the expression neutral but the eye on the color side has a single reflective sparkle, while the eye on the monochrome side is dull. Background, both halves: an empty studio with a horizon line of light. Across the bottom of the spread, in clean serif: "BEFORE / AFTER". Above the head, smaller text: "this is one person." Lighting is studio-flat with no shadows. Mood: the editorial of a quiet personal change. AVOID: writing text not specified in the prompt.

prompts.title: Imperfect Family Portrait
prompts.description: Twenty-three figures arranged formally, every one slightly imperfect
prompts.descriptionRu: Двадцать три фигуры в торжественной композиции, у каждой свой изъян
prompts.body: SCENE: An illustration of a very large extended family photograph being taken in front of an old country house at golden hour. Twenty-three figures are arranged in three rows: the back row standing, the middle row seated on chairs, the front row of children seated cross-legged on the grass. The composition is captured from in front by a tripod-mounted camera; the tripod itself is barely visible at the edge of the foreground. The grandmother (centermost figure) sits in the middle chair, posture proud, hands folded in her lap, the only figure smiling completely. Around her, every other figure is doing something slightly imperfect: one cousin in the back row is mid-sneeze; two children in the front are wrestling; one teen is checking a phone hidden under a sleeve; one figure has a finger raised in a silent objection; one toddler is escaping the frame to the right; one figure is looking the wrong way at a dog; the family dog itself is mid-shake, water flying. Two figures look directly into the camera, making eye contact. Each figure has a distinct outfit; no uniform. Behind the family, a yellow stucco farmhouse with green shutters, a wide oak tree to one side, a long table set up for the post-photo dinner. Lighting is direct golden hour from screen-right, halo on every head, long shadows running diagonally to the left. Mood: the photograph that is more honest than the photograph anyone wanted.

prompts.title: One Person, Nine Ages
prompts.description: 3x3 grid of the same pose at child, teen, adult, elder - all sincere
prompts.descriptionRu: 3x3 сетка одной позы в детстве, юности, взрослости, старости
prompts.body: SCENE: A concept illustration of a single figure depicted nine times across a 3x3 grid, each grid cell showing the figure at a different age - child, schoolchild, teen, young adult, mid-twenties, thirties, forties, sixties, eighties - but each in the exact same pose: sitting cross-legged on the same wooden floor, looking directly at the camera with a small calm smile, hands folded in lap. Each cell shares the same backdrop (a plain warm beige wall), the same pose, the same lighting. Only the figure ages. Outfits subtly evolve with each life-stage: a child's pajamas, a school uniform, a punky teen ensemble, a young adult's casual wear, professional wear, a parent's tired sweatshirt, a mature confident outfit, a comfortable retirement cardigan, a final elegant simple shirt. Each cell is bordered by a thin white line. Above the grid, small placeholder text reads: "ONE PERSON". Below the grid, smaller text: "every age is the same person." Lighting: identical warm side-light across all nine cells. Mood: the small clean honesty of a life laid out in equal squares. AVOID: writing text not specified.

prompts.title: Playground Just After
prompts.description: Empty playground at midnight, one swing still swaying, sneaker on woodchips
prompts.descriptionRu: Пустая площадка в полночь, качели ещё качаются, кроссовок на щепе
prompts.body: SCENE: A wide horizontal illustration of an empty playground at midnight, captured from a low angle. There are no figures in this image. The swings sway gently - one at a slight angle as if a child has just left it, two empty and still. A single sneaker sits on the woodchips beneath the swings. The slide has a small puddle of moonlight at its base. The merry-go-round is half-rotated and slowing. A red ball rests against the see-saw. A jacket is draped over the climbing dome. The chain-link fence behind the playground has a small gap in the bottom. Beyond the fence, suburban houses with most windows dark, a single warm yellow window glowing. The sky is deep navy with a fat full moon. Lighting is hard moonlight casting sharp blue shadows of the playground equipment across the woodchips. The mood is the precise moment after a child has been called inside - the equipment still warm with implication. Mood: an absence that's louder than any presence.

prompts.title: Terrarium World
prompts.description: House-sized glass terrarium with five tiny lives inside, watcher outside
prompts.descriptionRu: Стеклянный террариум размером с дом, пять крошечных жизней внутри
prompts.body: SCENE: A square 1:1 conceptual illustration of a giant translucent glass terrarium, the size of a small house, set on a featureless white plain. Inside the terrarium, a complete miniature world: rolling green hills, a tiny river, a forest of bonsai-scale trees, a pebbled path winding to a small thatched cottage with a chimney issuing a real wisp of smoke. Five tiny figures are scattered across this miniature world - one walking along the path, one fishing at the river, one on a ladder picking apples from a tiny orchard, one sitting on the cottage roof reading, one lying flat on the hill cloud-watching. Outside the terrarium, on the white plain, a single full-sized figure stands far in the foreground with the back to the camera, looking into the terrarium with both hands resting at the sides. The full-sized figure is small in the frame compared to the terrarium itself. The terrarium's curved glass catches the only warm light source - a sunset-colored sun that exists only inside it. The exterior plain is in cool flat daylight. Mood: a god looking at a world that doesn't know it is observed. NEGATIVE: smoke escaping the terrarium glass.
